nodes.summary: Counts chunks written with the adversarial chunker version, to verify poisoning was cleaned up.

nodes.name: calibration.py
nodes.summary: Calibrates the LLM judge against human labels: runs the judge over the labeled set (plain, paraphrased and bias variants) and reports agreement, Cohen's kappa with bootstrap intervals, paraphrase robustness, confusion matrices and human-human kappa.

nodes.name: compare.py
nodes.summary: Typed comparison of expected against actual output for exact-graded eval cases, supporting $contains, $subset, $any, $gte, $lte, $len, $startswith and $in operators and reporting mismatches by path.

nodes.name: judge.py
nodes.summary: The LLM-as-judge: grades a candidate output against a rubric's numbered criteria with the candidate fenced as untrusted data, fails content-free answers in code, runs order/length bias checks, and enforces self-grading and customer-data boundaries when judging consistently over k runs.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting eval metrics printed on every run: reliability curve and ECE, suggested interrupt threshold, attack-success rate per adversarial class, latency percentiles versus SLOs, cost and token usage from the step log, extraction and judge summaries, and per-AI-test pass^k stats with Wilson intervals.

nodes.name: production.py
nodes.summary: Scheduled production-quality jobs: a daily canary that runs real-model golden cases against the deployed bundle and fails below a floor, and a nightly stratified judged sample of AI verdicts graded against the verdict_reasoning rubric; both record quality_checks rows and register themselves in the job table.

nodes.name: load_labeled
nodes.summary: Loads every labeled calibration case from evals/labeled/*.yaml.

nodes.name: agreement_rate
nodes.summary: Fraction of positions where two boolean label lists agree.

nodes.name: cohen_kappa
nodes.summary: Computes Cohen's kappa between two boolean label lists, handling the degenerate all-agree case.

nodes.name: bootstrap_ci
nodes.summary: Percentile bootstrap 95 percent interval of a statistic over resampled human/judge label pairs with a fixed seed.

nodes.name: _stats
nodes.summary: Builds CriterionStats for one criterion from human and judge labels using agreement, kappa and bootstrap intervals.

nodes.name: calibrate
nodes.summary: Runs the judge over every labeled case with plain, paraphrased and bias variants on fresh budget trackers, enforces the customer-data boundary, and assembles the calibration report.

nodes.name: format_report
nodes.summary: Renders a calibration report as a fixed-width text table with paraphrase, bias, confusion and human-human sections.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Writes a calibration report as timestamped JSON into the runs directory.

nodes.name: LabeledCase
nodes.summary: A human-labeled calibration case: fixture output, rubric, per-criterion labels, overall label, origin and optional second-annotator labels.

nodes.name: CriterionStats
nodes.summary: Agreement, kappa, confidence interval and positive counts for one rubric criterion in a calibration.

nodes.name: CalibrationReport
nodes.summary: Full judge calibration report: judge model, sample size, per-criterion and overall stats, paraphrase robustness, bias checks, confusion matrices and human-human kappa.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Recursively compares an expected value against actual output, delegating single-key $op dicts to operators and returning path-named mismatch strings.

nodes.name: _operator
nodes.summary: Evaluates one comparison operator ($contains, $subset, $any, $gte, $lte, $len, $startswith, $in) against an actual value.

nodes.name: parse_criteria
nodes.summary: Extracts the numbered criterion lines from a rubric markdown body.

nodes.name: load_rubric
nodes.summary: Loads a rubric by name or path from the rubrics directory and parses its criteria and paraphrases into a Rubric.

nodes.name: content_free
nodes.summary: Detects outputs that say nothing (empty, punctuation-only or a bare heading) so they fail in code rather than being passed by a judge.

nodes.name: verified_spans
nodes.summary: Collects the citation quotes that code verified against the source, the only claims the judge may treat as established.

nodes.name: _negative_control
nodes.summary: Builds a failing JudgeResult with every criterion unmet for a content-free candidate, without calling a model.

nodes.name: render_candidate
nodes.summary: Renders a candidate output as text (strings as-is, other values as sorted JSON) for the judge prompt.

nodes.name: rubric_block
nodes.summary: Formats numbered rubric criteria into the system block the judge answers in order.

nodes.name: judge
nodes.summary: Runs one judge call: fences the candidate and verified spans with a nonce, builds cached system blocks from the prompt and rubric (reordered or padded per variant), extracts a JudgeDraft and maps answers back to CriterionResults.

nodes.name: agreement
nodes.summary: Fraction of criteria on which two judge results agree.

nodes.name: bias_checks
nodes.summary: Re-runs the judge with reversed criterion order and a length-padded control and reports agreement with the plain run.

nodes.name: same_model
nodes.summary: Treats dated and undated forms of a model id as the same model.

nodes.name: judge_consistently
nodes.summary: Runs the judge k times with self-grading and data-boundary checks, takes criteria by majority, and passes only when every run passes with identical answers, otherwise flagging judge_inconsistent for a person.

nodes.name: Rubric
nodes.summary: A parsed judging rubric: name, numbered criteria and paraphrased wordings, with wording() selecting the text per judge variant.

nodes.name: CriterionDraft
nodes.summary: Structured-output schema for one judged criterion: its number, whether it is met, and evidence.

nodes.name: JudgeDraft
nodes.summary: Structured-output schema the judge model fills: per-criterion drafts plus overall_pass.

nodes.name: SelfGrading
nodes.summary: Raised when the judge model is the same model that produced the output it would grade.

nodes.name: DataBoundary
nodes.summary: Raised when a non-Claude judge is asked to grade a case derived from customer data.

nodes.name: load_slos
nodes.summary: Loads per-target latency SLOs from config/slos.yaml.

nodes.name: _confidence_cases
nodes.summary: Collects (confidence, correct) pairs from executed cases whose output carries a confidence and whose expectation names a status.

nodes.name: reliability
nodes.summary: Builds an equal-width reliability curve over verdict confidence and computes expected calibration error.

nodes.name: suggested_threshold
nodes.summary: Reads the lowest confidence bin edge above which every bin reaches the target accuracy, as a suggested interrupt threshold.

nodes.name: attack_success
nodes.summary: Computes attack-success rate per adversarial class and overall, excluding skipped cases.

nodes.name: percentile
nodes.summary: Nearest-rank percentile of a list of values.

nodes.name: latency_by_target
nodes.summary: Computes p50/p95/p99 latency per target and flags p95 breaches against the configured SLOs.

nodes.name: cost_by_target
nodes.summary: Sums case cost in USD per eval target.

nodes.name: usage_since
nodes.summary: Sums tokens and USD of model-bearing steps appended to the step log after a byte offset, giving one case's own usage.

nodes.name: usage_between
nodes.summary: Sums tokens and USD of model-bearing steps in the step log started within a time window.

nodes.name: extraction_summary
nodes.summary: Computes field accuracy and support precision over extraction cases.

nodes.name: judge_summary
nodes.summary: Summarizes judged cases: overall passes and per-rubric-criterion met rates.

nodes.name: wilson
nodes.summary: Wilson score interval for an observed rate, honest at small n and at 0 or 1.

nodes.name: ai_test_stats
nodes.summary: Per model-backed target: pass@1, pass^k, false PASS, false FAIL and refusal rates with Wilson intervals, plus cost per task.

nodes.name: _record
nodes.summary: Inserts a quality_checks row with the current release bundle id, pass flag and measured values.

nodes.name: canary_ids
nodes.summary: Reads the canary case ids and pass-rate floor from config/canary.yaml.

nodes.name: canary
nodes.summary: Daily canary job: runs the canary golden cases against the real model, records the pass rate, and raises when it falls below the floor; does nothing without a model key.

nodes.name: judged_sample
nodes.summary: Nightly job that stratifies the last day's AI verdicts, judges up to 20 against the verdict_reasoning rubric, and records the result as advisory unless the judge's calibration meets the gate.

nodes.name: regress.py
nodes.summary: Regression check against the previous eval run: flips, confidence deltas, cost delta, golden-hash changes, ASR increases and p95 breaches, with model-backed targets gated on Wilson bounds of pass^k and false-PASS rates and tenant-clustered paired differences; its exit code drives CI.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: The eval runner behind `ccp evals run`: loads golden and adversarial cases, runs each target (k times for model-backed cases) in a scratch database, compares or judges results, computes run metrics and writes the JSON report used as the regression baseline.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for the golden dataset and eval run reports: golden cases, case and judge results, level summaries, reliability bins, latency percentiles, Wilson intervals, per-AI-test stats and the overall run report.

nodes.name: thresholds.py
nodes.summary: Reads config/evaluation.yaml for the human-interrupt confidence threshold used to route low-confidence verdicts to review.

nodes.name: tier2.py
nodes.summary: Tier 2 evaluator: for one test and subject it runs one hybrid retrieval, frames the evidence behind a nonce fence, makes one structured extraction call, verifies citations, applies the rule in code and computes confidence to produce a Verdict that stores the exact request and response for replay.
nodes.languageNotes: Embodies the 'models extract, code decides' pattern: the LLM fills a schema and deterministic code verifies quotes and applies the rule.

nodes.name: load_gates
nodes.summary: Loads regression gates from YAML into a Gates model.

nodes.name: load_report
nodes.summary: Loads a saved eval run report from JSON.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Compares a current run to its baseline, reporting flips (or treating them as noise for model-backed cases), confidence and cost deltas, ASR and latency regressions, bound breaches and refusal breaches, with a strict mode for the keyed nightly job.

nodes.name: refusal_breaches
nodes.summary: Lists targets whose model refused more runs than their gate allows.

nodes.name: latest_judge_agreement
nodes.summary: Reads the overall agreement from the newest judge calibration report.

nodes.name: check_bounds
nodes.summary: Checks an AI test's Wilson bounds against its gate's floor and ceiling and explains when a bound could not be gated.

nodes.name: clustered_se
nodes.summary: Tenant-clustered (CR1) standard error of the mean of paired differences.

nodes.name: paired_differences
nodes.summary: Per AI test, the mean change in per-case pass rate between two runs with a tenant-clustered 95 percent interval (reported, never gating).

nodes.name: format_regression
nodes.summary: Renders a Regression as human-readable text lines for the CLI.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.summary: Per-target regression gate: pass^k floor, false-PASS ceiling, minimum cases and FAIL cases, and maximum refusal rate.

nodes.name: Gates
nodes.summary: Default and per-target gates plus the judge's minimum agreement, with for_target resolving the effective gate.

nodes.name: Regression
nodes.summary: Result of comparing two runs: flips, new and first failures, confidence and cost deltas, golden changes, ASR increases, latency breaches and bound breaches, with exit_code for CI.

nodes.name: load_cases
nodes.summary: Loads golden cases from the golden directory and returns them with each file's SHA-256 hash.

nodes.name: all_cases
nodes.summary: Loads the golden, adversarial or combined suite, carrying the adversarial file's hash along.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Filters cases by level, tag or case id.

nodes.name: missing_providers
nodes.summary: Lists the provider keys a case still needs (its own requirements and its judge model) unless providers or a judge are injected.

nodes.name: _failed
nodes.summary: Builds a failed CaseResult carrying an error message and latency.

nodes.name: _compact
nodes.summary: Converts a target's output to JSON-native form with long strings truncated for storage on the result.

nodes.name: generating_models
nodes.summary: Lists every model that can produce what the judge grades, so self-grading can be refused.

nodes.name: judge_model_for
nodes.summary: Chooses the judge model for a case: the cross-family judge for fixture cases when configured, otherwise the Claude judge, always for customer-derived cases.

nodes.name: run_case
nodes.summary: Runs one golden case: checks providers, resolves the target, executes it inside an eval step, compares expected values, optionally judges consistently, and records latency, usage, cost and trace id on a CaseResult.

nodes.name: fold_runs
nodes.summary: Folds k runs of one case into one result that passes only when every run passed, keeping each run's status and summing cost and tokens.

nodes.name: repeat
nodes.summary: Runs a case k times when a model is involved (once otherwise) and folds the runs.

nodes.name: run_unit_tests
nodes.summary: Runs pytest over tests/unit as a subprocess and returns the unit level summary.

nodes.name: parse_pytest_summary
nodes.summary: Parses pytest's footer into a LevelSummary, counting an unparsable non-zero exit as one failure.

nodes.name: compute_metrics
nodes.summary: Assembles RunMetrics from case results: reliability and ECE, suggested threshold, ASR, latency vs SLOs, cost, extraction, judge and per-AI-test stats.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs a full eval: unit tests, then every case (repeated k times) against a scratch database with a fresh step-log run, and returns a RunReport with level summaries, metrics, git commit and golden and bundle hashes.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Writes a run report under its id and promotes it to latest.json as the regression baseline unless told not to.

nodes.name: write_threshold
nodes.summary: Records an interrupt threshold read off the reliability curve into config/evaluation.yaml.

nodes.name: format_metrics
nodes.summary: Renders run metrics (reliability, ASR, latency, cost, extraction, judge and AI-test stats) as text for the CLI.

nodes.name: format_table
nodes.summary: Renders the run's per-level pass table, failures and metrics as text.

nodes.name: GoldenCase
nodes.summary: A golden eval case: id, level, difficulty, source, target, tenant, input, expected values, grading mode, rubric and tags, with helpers telling whether it is model-backed or customer-derived.

nodes.name: CriterionResult
nodes.summary: Judge outcome for one rubric criterion: name, met flag and evidence.

nodes.name: JudgeResult
nodes.summary: A judge's result: criteria, overall_pass, model, rubric, variant, guardrail events and usage.

nodes.name: CaseResult
nodes.summary: Result of running one case: pass/skip, mismatches, latency, error, trace id, judge result, cost, tokens and per-run statuses.

nodes.name: LevelSummary
nodes.summary: Passed, total and skipped counts for one eval level.

nodes.name: ReliabilityBin
nodes.summary: One bin of the reliability curve: bounds, count, mean confidence and accuracy.

nodes.name: LatencyPercentiles
nodes.summary: Latency percentiles of one target with its p95 SLO and breach flag.

nodes.name: Interval
nodes.summary: A rate with its 95 percent Wilson interval and case count.

nodes.name: AITestStats
nodes.summary: One AI test's baseline read by the nightly gate: pass@1, pass^k, false PASS/FAIL, refusals and cost.

nodes.name: RunMetrics
nodes.summary: Metrics of one run: reliability and ECE, suggested threshold, ASR, latency, cost, extraction, judge and AI-test stats.

nodes.name: RunReport
nodes.summary: Report of one eval run with timing, git commit, golden and bundle hashes, case results, level summaries and metrics; all_passed holds when every case passed or was skipped and the unit row passed.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads config/evaluation.yaml into an EvaluationConfig.

nodes.name: interrupt_threshold
nodes.summary: Returns the configured confidence threshold below which a verdict interrupts for human review.

nodes.name: EvaluationConfig
nodes.summary: Schema of config/evaluation.yaml: the interrupt threshold and when it was read from the reliability curve.

nodes.name: subjects_for
nodes.summary: Lists the subjects a tier 2 test evaluates: repositories with policy documents for GH-4, active HR persons for HR-3, or the tenant.

nodes.name: subject_entity
nodes.summary: Extracts the entity id from a subject string, or None for the tenant.

nodes.name: extraction_instruction
nodes.summary: Builds the tier 2 instruction text with the fence declaration; fenced evidence travels separately as document blocks.

nodes.name: subject_names
nodes.summary: Returns the names a quote must contain (display name, employee id) to prove a document belongs to the subject.

nodes.name: build_query
nodes.summary: Builds the retrieval query from the test's template and a one-line subject description for the prompt.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs tier 2 for one test and subject: retrieves and fits evidence to the context ceiling, frames it, extracts structured fields, records spend, verifies citations, applies the rule in code, computes confidence and returns a replayable Verdict (needs_review when evidence or citations fall short).

nodes.name: Providers
nodes.summary: Bundle of external AI dependencies for the tiers (embedder, reranker, LLM client, retrieval config), built from Settings.

nodes.name: AITierUnavailable
nodes.summary: Raised when no model client is configured, so the evaluation record is parked instead of failing.

nodes.name: anthropic_client.py
nodes.summary: The Anthropic implementation of LLMClient and the only module importing the SDK: structured extraction with one re-ask, plain completion, tool-use chat, and the batches API, with retry/backoff mapped onto the queue's error taxonomy, pinned-model and price checks, budget charging, and Bedrock routing per cell.

nodes.name: budget.py
nodes.summary: Hard run budgets enforced inside every model client: RunBudget caps tokens per call, USD, wall-clock seconds and tool calls, and BudgetTracker charges each call and raises BudgetExceeded or RunStopped.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: Defines the LLMClient protocol every model call goes through (extract, complete, chat) with its request/response value types, a deterministic StubLLMClient for tests and keyless runs, and the provider factory that picks the Anthropic or Bedrock client.

nodes.name: context.py
nodes.summary: Per-call-type context ceilings from config/context_ceilings.yaml: a deterministic token estimator, a fit routine that drops the lowest-priority items until a call fits (refusing if pinned items alone exceed it), squeezed ceilings for stress probes, and result previews.

nodes.name: errors.py
nodes.summary: Error taxonomy for the model layer that maps provider failures onto the queue's retry semantics: throttled, retryable and terminal errors, budget exceeded, run stopped and unpriced model, plus an HTTP status classifier.

nodes.name: system_param
nodes.summary: Converts SystemBlocks into the API's system parameter with an explicit cache_control breakpoint on the cached block.

nodes.name: _usage
nodes.summary: Builds a Usage record from the API's raw usage, pricing it with the cost table (batch-discounted when applicable).

nodes.name: _user_content
nodes.summary: Builds user content with image/PDF attachments first, then evidence documents as text blocks, then the instruction; keeps a plain string when there are none.

nodes.name: _to_dict
nodes.summary: Serializes an SDK response object to a plain dict for storage and replay.

nodes.name: _Malformed
nodes.summary: Sentinel for a model answer that failed schema parsing: no usage, no parsed output, so the client re-asks once.

nodes.name: AnthropicClient
nodes.summary: LLMClient over the Anthropic SDK (or Bedrock via cell routing): structured extract with streaming parse and one re-ask, complete, tool-use chat with thinking blocks, and batch submit/status/collect, with retry and backoff, pinned-model and price checks, context capping and budget charging.

nodes.name: BatchItem
nodes.summary: One request in a message batch with the same layout as an online call and an optional schema; params builds the API body.

nodes.name: BatchResult
nodes.summary: One collected batch result keyed by custom id, carrying parsed output or text, usage, or an error.

nodes.name: RunBudget
nodes.summary: Hard caps for one run (tokens per call, USD, seconds, tool calls) built from Settings; lowered lets a graph tighten but never raise a cap.

nodes.name: BudgetTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks a run's spend against its RunBudget with an injectable clock: charges each call's context and cost, counts tool calls, checks the wall clock and honors stop requests by raising BudgetExceeded or RunStopped.

nodes.name: blocks_as_json
nodes.summary: Serializes system blocks as plain dicts for logging and replay.

nodes.name: with_documents
nodes.summary: Joins documents and the instruction into one string (documents first) for clients that see a single text.

nodes.name: tool_result_message
nodes.summary: Builds the user-turn tool_result block answering one tool call, using the guarded fenced text when given.

nodes.name: build_client
nodes.summary: Selects the model provider: an explicit stub, otherwise the Anthropic client (Bedrock in a Bedrock cell).

nodes.name: try_build_client
nodes.summary: Returns a client or None when no provider is configured, so callers park AI-tier work instead of failing.

nodes.name: Attachment
nodes.summary: Image or PDF bytes the model reads, logged only by SHA-256 digest and description.

nodes.name: SystemBlock
nodes.summary: One system prompt block with a flag marking the prompt-cache breakpoint.

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.summary: Token usage of a call (input, output, cache read/write) with its USD cost.

nodes.name: Extraction
nodes.summary: Structured-output result: parsed model, usage, model id and raw request/response.

nodes.name: Completion
nodes.summary: Plain-text completion result with usage, model id and raw request/response.

nodes.name: ToolCall
nodes.summary: One tool call requested by the model: id, tool name and arguments.

nodes.name: ChatTurn
nodes.summary: One turn of a tool loop: text, tool calls, stop reason, usage, raw exchange and assistant content to send back.

nodes.name: LLMClient
nodes.summary: Protocol every model client implements: extract (structured output), complete (plain text) and chat (one tool-loop turn), each charged to a BudgetTracker.

nodes.name: StubLLMClient
nodes.summary: Deterministic test double for keyless runs: returns canned objects from pluggable handlers, charges fixed tokens and cost, and records every call.

nodes.name: estimate_tokens
nodes.summary: Deterministic token estimate at four characters per token, rounded up.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Returns the active context ceilings: the innermost squeeze override during a probe, otherwise those read from config/context_ceilings.yaml.

nodes.name: squeezed
nodes.summary: Returns every ceiling scaled to a fraction for the duration of a stress probe.

nodes.name: fit
nodes.summary: Drops the lowest-priority (later among equals) unpinned items until the rest fit the budget, refusing when pinned items alone exceed it.

nodes.name: preview
nodes.summary: Returns roughly the first N tokens of a stored result as a preview.

nodes.name: ContextCeilingExceeded
nodes.summary: Raised when pinned material (instructions, cited spans) alone exceeds a call's ceiling.

nodes.name: Ceilings
nodes.summary: Context ceilings per call type plus swap and preview sizes; of() returns a call type's ceiling.

nodes.name: Item
nodes.summary: One candidate context item with key, token count, priority and pinned flag.

nodes.name: classify_status
nodes.summary: Maps an HTTP status code to a throttled, retryable or terminal model error.

nodes.name: RetryableModelError
nodes.summary: Transient model-layer failure retried with backoff; a RetryableError for the queue.

nodes.name: ThrottledModelError
nodes.summary: Rate-limit or overload error that waits without spending a queue attempt.

nodes.name: TerminalModelError
nodes.summary: Permanent model-layer failure dead-lettered on first occurrence.

nodes.name: BudgetExceeded
nodes.summary: A run budget cap was hit; the run stops and the record dead-letters naming the cap.

nodes.name: RunStopped
nodes.summary: A person stopped the run; it ends cancelled at the next boundary and is not retried.

nodes.name: UnpricedModel
nodes.summary: Refusal for a model with no known price, since its spend could not be capped.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Table of pinned model ids CCP may call and what each accepts: refuses moving aliases and unknown ids, resolves model family, and decides thinking/effort parameters per call type without sending sampling parameters.

nodes.name: openai_judge.py
nodes.summary: A cross-family judge client speaking the Chat Completions protocol over httpx for fixture-only eval suites; it redacts text before sending, refuses unpriced models, charges the budget and implements only extract.

nodes.name: cost.py
nodes.summary: USD-per-million-token price table for the models CCP uses, with prefix matching for dated ids, long-prompt rate cards, cache read/write pricing and batch discount, used by the step logger and budget tracker.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the retrieval layer (chunker, embeddings, index, hybrid query, rerank, contextual enrichment, distractors, calibration); contains only a docstring.

nodes.name: cache.py
nodes.summary: Tenant-scoped content-hash caches for embeddings and contextual enrichment stored in Postgres under RLS, with deterministic SHA-256 keys and insert-if-absent writes.

nodes.name: family
nodes.summary: Returns the vendor family of a model id (a stub maps to its stand-in's family).

nodes.name: spec_for
nodes.summary: Looks up a pinned model's spec, refusing aliases (naming the dated id to use), -latest ids and unknown ids.

nodes.name: sampling_params
nodes.summary: Builds thinking and effort parameters for one call (adaptive reasoning or thinking off), never sampling parameters.

nodes.name: thinks
nodes.summary: Tells whether a call with given params can spend max_tokens on thinking.

nodes.name: ModelSpec
nodes.summary: Spec of one pinned model: id, adaptive thinking support, whether it thinks by default, how to turn thinking off and its effort setting.

nodes.name: UnpinnedModel
nodes.summary: Refusal for a moving alias, -latest id or unknown model id.

nodes.name: CrossFamilyJudgeClient
nodes.summary: Judge-only LLM client for a non-Claude model over the Chat Completions API with strict JSON-schema output: redacts secrets, refuses unpriced models, retries classified errors, charges the budget, and refuses complete and chat.

nodes.name: is_priced
nodes.summary: Reports whether the price table knows a model, used to refuse unpriced models before a call.

nodes.name: price_for
nodes.summary: Returns the price for a model by exact id or longest known prefix, zero when unknown.

nodes.name: estimate_usd
nodes.summary: Estimates the USD cost of a call from input, output and cache tokens, using the long-prompt card and batch discount where applicable.

nodes.name: Price
nodes.summary: Per-million-token prices for input, output, cache write and cache read, with an optional long-prompt rate card.

nodes.name: embedding_key
nodes.summary: SHA-256 cache key over model, input type and text.

nodes.name: enrichment_key
nodes.summary: SHA-256 cache key over model, prompt version, document hash and chunk hash.

nodes.name: get_embeddings
nodes.summary: Fetches cached embedding vectors for a set of keys from the tenant-scoped embedding cache.

nodes.name: put_embeddings
nodes.summary: Writes embedding vectors to the tenant-scoped cache in one transaction, ignoring existing keys.

nodes.name: get_enrichment
nodes.summary: Fetches a cached contextual-enrichment string by key.

nodes.name: put_enrichment
nodes.summary: Stores a contextual-enrichment string with its model and prompt version, ignoring existing keys.

nodes.name: calibration.py
nodes.summary: Calibrates retrieval confidence for an (embedding model, reranker) pair: derives distractor-score percentile thresholds as the noise floor and fits isotonic reliability curves that map a top score to a measured hit rate.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements pool-adjacent-violators isotonic regression by hand with a running max so Laplace smoothing cannot break monotonicity.

nodes.name: Calibration
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a calibration result: the config key of the model pair, the measured distractor-score thresholds and the sample count.

nodes.name: percentile
nodes.summary: Returns the nearest-rank p-th percentile of a score list, rounded, or 0.0 for an empty list.

nodes.name: calibrate
nodes.summary: Runs each of the tenant's golden queries with distractors included, takes the best distractor score per query, and builds percentile Thresholds keyed by embedding model and reranker; raises when no distractor scored.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Returns a deep copy of the retrieval config with the calibration's thresholds stored under its model-pair key.

nodes.name: fit_reliability
nodes.summary: Fits a non-decreasing hit-rate curve over top scores by pool-adjacent-violators isotonic regression, merging ties and applying (hits+1)/(n+2) smoothing, and returns it as Reliability bins.

nodes.name: reliability_curves
nodes.summary: Builds the pooled reliability curve for a metrics report's model pair plus one curve per evidence type that has the minimum number of samples.

nodes.name: record_reliability
nodes.summary: Returns a deep copy of the retrieval config with fitted reliability curves merged in.

nodes.name: chunker.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, versioned, page-aware chunker that splits evidence text into blank-line blocks packed into ~700-character windows that never cross a page, with content-addressed chunk ids and source offsets for citations.

nodes.name: ChunkDraft
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one chunk before indexing: content-hash id, evidence and subject ids, source ref, page, ordinal, text, text hash and [start, end) offsets into the source.

nodes.name: chunk_id_for
nodes.summary: Derives a 32-hex-character content-addressed chunk id from tenant, evidence id, chunker version, page, ordinal and text via SHA-256.

nodes.name: _blocks
nodes.summary: Splits text into blank-line separated blocks of stripped lines so consecutive table rows stay in one block.

nodes.name: _split_long
nodes.summary: Splits a block longer than the cap at sentence boundaries, hard-splitting any single sentence that still exceeds it.

nodes.name: chunk_text
nodes.summary: Packs blocks (after long-block splitting) into windows of roughly the target size joined by blank lines.

nodes.name: offsets
nodes.summary: Locates each window's [start, end) span in the source by aligning non-whitespace characters, returning None rather than guessing when a window is not a contiguous run of the source.

nodes.name: chunk_evidence
nodes.summary: Chunks an Evidence record page by page (or as one text), producing ChunkDrafts with content-hash ids, running ordinals, text hashes and source offsets.

nodes.name: compare.py
nodes.summary: Paired statistical comparison of two retrieval configurations (embedding model and reranker) on the golden queries, reporting per-query MRR and Recall@5 deltas with seeded bootstrap intervals, an exact sign test and latency medians; it informs but never switches the serving model.

nodes.name: Side
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming one side of a comparison: its embedder, optional reranker and index generation, with a 'model|reranker' display name.

nodes.name: Pair
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of one golden query's paired results: reciprocal rank, Recall@5 and latency for baseline and candidate.

nodes.name: bootstrap_ci
nodes.summary: Computes a seeded bootstrap confidence interval for the mean of paired deltas so a rerun yields identical bounds.

nodes.name: sign_test
nodes.summary: Exact two-sided binomial sign-test p-value over the queries that changed, ties dropped.

nodes.name: Comparison
nodes.summary: Accumulates paired query results and summarizes them into mean deltas, 95% intervals, win/loss/tie counts, per-evidence-type deltas, latency medians and a verdict (candidate_better, candidate_worse or no_detectable_difference).

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Evaluates both sides' golden queries against their own generation with distractors excluded and pairs the outcomes by query id, recording unmatched queries as unresolved.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Concatenates several per-tenant Comparisons of one configuration pair into a single Comparison.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic model and YAML persistence for config/retrieval.yaml: query knobs (ef_search, candidates, top_k, RRF k), measured distractor thresholds and reliability curves, plus the calibrated retrieval-confidence lookup with its fallback order.

nodes.name: Thresholds
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of the best-distractor score percentiles per golden query (the noise floor), with measurement date, query count and score kind.

nodes.name: ReliabilityBin
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of one reliability bin: the highest top score it covers, the smoothed measured hit rate and its sample count.

nodes.name: Reliability
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a fitted reliability curve: measurement date, sample count, score kind and ordered bins.

nodes.name: RetrievalConfig
nodes.summary: Pydantic retrieval configuration with HNSW ef_search, candidate count, top_k and RRF k, plus thresholds and reliability curves keyed by model pair (and evidence type), with key-building helpers.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads RetrievalConfig from config/retrieval.yaml, returning defaults when the file is absent.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Writes a RetrievalConfig back to YAML under an explanatory comment header.

nodes.name: quality_from_thresholds
nodes.summary: Interpolates the fraction of the distractor noise distribution a score exceeds, or None when the pair is unmeasured.

nodes.name: reliability_at
nodes.summary: Returns the smoothed hit rate of the first reliability bin that covers a score, or the last bin's rate above the curve.

nodes.name: retrieval_confidence
nodes.summary: Maps a top score to a retrieval confidence factor, preferring the evidence type's reliability curve, then the pooled curve, then the noise floor, and names the method used.

nodes.name: now_stamp
nodes.summary: Returns today's UTC date as an ISO string for measurement stamps.

nodes.name: contextual.py
nodes.summary: Index-time contextual chunk enrichment: one short LLM call per chunk with the nonce-fenced whole document in a cached system prefix, returning a succinct situating context with cost and token usage.

nodes.name: Enrichment
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass with a generated chunk context, its USD cost and token count.

nodes.name: document_sha
nodes.summary: SHA-256 hex digest of a document, used as part of the enrichment cache key.

nodes.name: enrich
nodes.summary: Loads the contextual prompt, frames the truncated document and the chunk inside one nonce fence as untrusted evidence, and asks the LLM for a short situating context under the run budget.

nodes.name: distractors.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic per-tenant generator of distractor evidence (prior-year access reviews, other employees' training certificates, near-duplicate policy drafts, unrelated policies) that is chunked, embedded and stored flagged is_distractor to stress retrieval metrics and calibration.

nodes.name: Distractor
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one generated distractor document: template, evidence type, optional subject, title and markdown text.

nodes.name: _review
nodes.summary: Generates a fake prior-period user access review report with a random systems table and a finding.

nodes.name: _certificate
nodes.summary: Generates a security awareness training certificate for a fictitious other employee.

nodes.name: _policy_variant
nodes.summary: Generates a near-duplicate security disclosure policy draft with randomized response timelines.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Produces a reproducible list of distractors for a tenant from a seed derived from the tenant id, sampling the four templates by weight.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Chunks generated distractors, embeds the ones missing from the embedding cache, and inserts them into chunks flagged is_distractor; returns how many distractor chunks exist.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Deletes every distractor chunk of the tenant and returns the number removed.

nodes.name: embeddings.py
nodes.summary: Single seam for every embedding call: Voyage and OpenAI HTTPS clients with secret redaction, retry/backoff and error-taxonomy mapping, a keyless deterministic hashing client for offline runs, provider selection from settings, and pgvector literal helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for EmbeddingClient so hosted and local clients satisfy the interface structurally without inheritance.

nodes.name: ProviderTermsNotRecorded
nodes.summary: Error raised when a provider that needs an operator action (the Voyage training opt-out) is configured before that action is recorded.

nodes.name: require_voyage_terms
nodes.summary: Raises ProviderTermsNotRecorded unless settings record the Voyage training opt-out.

nodes.name: EmbeddingResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of embedding vectors with total tokens and USD cost.

nodes.name: EmbeddingClient
nodes.summary: Protocol every embedder satisfies: a model id, a dimension and embed(texts, input_type).

nodes.name: EmbeddingUnavailable
nodes.summary: Retryable model error signalling the embedding provider is unreachable, so retrieval degrades to the lexical arm.

nodes.name: _retry
nodes.summary: Runs an HTTP call up to three times with exponential backoff and jitter, mapping status errors through the model error taxonomy and transport errors to EmbeddingUnavailable.

nodes.name: HashingEmbeddingClient
nodes.summary: Keyless deterministic embedder using signed feature hashing over unigrams and bigrams into 1024-dimensional L2-normalized vectors, so the pipeline runs offline.

nodes.name: VoyageEmbeddingClient
nodes.summary: Voyage embeddings client (voyage-3-large, 1024 dims) posting redacted batches of 128 over httpx, with retries, a per-cell endpoint override and cost estimation.

nodes.name: OpenAIEmbeddingClient
nodes.summary: OpenAI text-embedding-3-large client at 1024 dims posting redacted batches over httpx with retries and cost estimation.

nodes.name: build_embedding_client
nodes.summary: Selects the configured hosted embedder (OpenAI, or Voyage after the opt-out check and with the cell's endpoint) when its key is present, else the hashing client.

nodes.name: EmbeddingModelUnavailable
nodes.summary: Error raised when no client can be built for a named embedding model because its provider key is missing.

nodes.name: embedder_for
nodes.summary: Builds a client for one named embedding model (for example a generation's), refusing any silent substitution.

nodes.name: vector_literal
nodes.summary: Formats a vector in pgvector input syntax with seven decimal places.

nodes.name: parse_vector
nodes.summary: Parses a pgvector text literal back into a list of floats.

nodes.name: gates.py
nodes.summary: Per-evidence-type retrieval quality gates loaded from config/retrieval_gates.yaml (Recall@5, MRR, distractor-at-1, minimum queries) that a parser, chunker, embedding model or reranker change must pass before it ships.

nodes.name: TypeGate
nodes.summary: Pydantic thresholds for one evidence type: minimum queries, Recall@5 floor, MRR floor and maximum distractor-at-1 share.

nodes.name: RetrievalGates
nodes.summary: Pydantic gate set with a default TypeGate plus per-type and per-embedding-model overrides, merged by for_type.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads RetrievalGates from config/retrieval_gates.yaml, defaulting when the file is missing.

nodes.name: GateOutcome
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of one evidence type's gate result: its metrics, whether it was gated, and any breaches.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Evaluates each evidence type in a metrics report against its merged gate, reporting types below min_queries as ungated and listing threshold breaches.

nodes.name: blocking
nodes.summary: Collects every reason a report fails: per-type breaches and unresolved golden queries.

nodes.name: generations.py
nodes.summary: Insert-only index generations and versioned chunk sets: names a generation by embedding model and chunker, records chained activations, chunk sets and tombstones per evidence observation, and projects the serving chunks table from a generation's newest sets.
nodes.languageNotes: Append-only versioning: the serving `chunks` table is a rebuildable projection, and AS_OF_SOURCE uses DISTINCT ON to pick each entity's newest set as of a time.

nodes.name: Generation
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing an index generation: id, embedding model, chunker version, and optional activation time and reason.

nodes.name: generation_id
nodes.summary: Derives a stable 'gen-' id from a SHA-256 of the embedding model and chunker version.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Idempotently inserts the generation row for an embedding model and returns its id.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Looks up a generation by id, returning None when absent.

nodes.name: active
nodes.summary: Returns the generation serving at a given time (now by default) from the latest activation.

nodes.name: activate
nodes.summary: Appends an activation record (first, gate_passed or forced) with its gate measurements as JSON.

nodes.name: history
nodes.summary: Lists every generation with its set and chunk-version counts, last activation time and whether it is serving.

nodes.name: content_sha
nodes.summary: Hashes what a chunk set holds (chunk ids, offsets, scope and an enrichment-context hash) to detect changed documents.

nodes.name: latest_sets
nodes.summary: Maps each evidence entity to its newest set's content hash in a generation, or None when tombstoned.

nodes.name: record_set
nodes.summary: Inserts a new chunk set and one chunk_versions row per draft (text, context, pgvector embedding, offsets) for an evidence observation.

nodes.name: record_tombstone
nodes.summary: Inserts an empty chunk set marking an evidence entity retired in a generation.

nodes.name: project
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the serving chunks table from a generation's newest set per evidence entity and drops distractors embedded with another model.

nodes.name: chunk_from_versions
nodes.summary: Reads chunks that are no longer served back from chunk_versions by id, across any generation.

nodes.name: hybrid.py
nodes.summary: Hybrid retrieval in one SQL statement: Postgres full-text and pgvector cosine arms fused by reciprocal rank fusion under row-level security, optional reranking, graceful degradation on provider outages, and as-of or per-generation queries over versioned chunks.
nodes.languageNotes: One CTE pipeline (fts, dense, FULL OUTER JOIN fused) with SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan and ef_search per transaction; the versioned variant reuses the same body over a MATERIALIZED as-of relation.

nodes.name: EmbeddingModelMismatch
nodes.summary: Error raised when stored chunks or a generation were embedded with a different model than the query embedder.

nodes.name: RetrievedChunk
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of one retrieved chunk with lexical, dense, fused and rerank scores and ranks, distractor flag and source offsets, plus top_score and rerank-text helpers.

nodes.name: RetrievalResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a query's fused candidates, final chunks, degradation events, models and generation/as-of context, with a degraded flag.

nodes.name: or_tsquery
nodes.summary: Builds an OR-joined Postgres tsquery from the unique lowercase alphanumeric tokens of a query.

nodes.name: _check_model
nodes.summary: Raises EmbeddingModelMismatch when the serving chunks hold vectors from another embedding model.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Embeds the query, runs the fused full-text plus HNSW cosine SQL (or the versioned as-of variant) with per-query ef_search and iterative scan, then optionally reranks to top_k, recording embedding or rerank outages as events.

nodes.name: index.py
nodes.summary: Maintains the retrieval index over current evidence: filters inadmissible evidence, chunks it, optionally enriches with context, embeds through the cache, records versioned chunk sets in the embedder's generation, and upserts the serving chunks table when that generation serves.

nodes.name: IndexSummary
nodes.summary: Dataclass of index refresh counters: generation and serving status, chunks upserted, unchanged and deleted, sets and tombstones written, embeddings and enrichments computed or cached, cost and events.

nodes.name: _target
nodes.summary: Decides whether the embedder's generation serves, activating it as 'first' for a new tenant or 'forced' on rebuild, otherwise marking it a candidate.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Full index refresh step: drops inadmissible evidence, chunks documents, reuses or generates contextual enrichments, embeds through the cache, writes chunk sets and tombstones for changed or retired documents, and upserts or deletes serving chunks in one transaction.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Reports chunk counts by evidence type and embedding model, distractor and contextualized counts, the active generation and the number of generations.

nodes.name: chunk_count
nodes.summary: Counts non-distractor chunks in the tenant's serving index.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Retrieval quality metrics over the golden query set: loads queries, resolves relevant chunk ids by evidence id and substring, and computes Recall@k, MRR and nDCG@k plus per-type hit and distractor statistics into a MetricsReport.

nodes.name: Relevant
nodes.summary: Pydantic spec of a relevant chunk named by evidence id or prefix plus a required text substring.

nodes.name: RetrievalQuery
nodes.summary: Pydantic golden retrieval query with tenant, text, evidence type, optional subject, relevant chunk specs and tags.

nodes.name: RetrievalGolden
nodes.summary: Pydantic root model of the golden retrieval YAML: a list of queries.

nodes.name: load_queries
nodes.summary: Loads and validates golden retrieval queries from evals/golden/retrieval.yaml.

nodes.name: resolve_relevant
nodes.summary: Resolves a query's relevant specs to concrete chunk ids through ILIKE substring matches on evidence id or prefix.

nodes.name: recall_at_k
nodes.summary: Fraction of relevant chunk ids found in the top k of a ranking.

nodes.name: reciprocal_rank
nodes.summary: Reciprocal of the first relevant chunk's rank, or 0.0 when none is ranked.

nodes.name: ndcg_at_k
nodes.summary: Binary-relevance normalized discounted cumulative gain at k.

nodes.name: QueryOutcome
nodes.summary: Dataclass of one query's results: Recall@5, reciprocal rank, nDCG@10, counts, top score, events, latency, hit-at-k and distractor statistics.

nodes.name: TypeMetrics
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of per-evidence-type aggregates: query count, Recall@5, MRR and distractor shares.

nodes.name: MetricsReport
nodes.summary: Dataclass collecting query outcomes for one model pair with mean Recall@5, MRR, nDCG@10 and distractor-at-1 properties, per-type aggregation and a JSON summary.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Combines several tenants' reports of the same (embedding model, reranker) pair into one, rejecting mixed pairs.

nodes.name: evaluate_queries
nodes.summary: Runs each of the tenant's golden queries through hybrid retrieval with timing, resolving relevant chunks first and recording unresolved ones, and builds a MetricsReport.

nodes.name: reembed.py
nodes.summary: Gated re-embedding into a new index generation: refreshes with the candidate model beside the serving one, measures both on golden queries, and switches serving only if no overall or per-type Recall@5/MRR regression exceeds tolerance (or when forced).

nodes.name: GateResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of the re-embedding gate verdict with reasons and both sides' metric summaries, serializable with the tolerance.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: Fails a candidate report that resolves no queries or loses more than the tolerance on Recall@5 or MRR, overall or for any evidence type, against the serving report.

nodes.name: ReembedResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass of a re-embed run: candidate and serving generations, refresh summary, gate result, whether it switched, rows projected and events.

nodes.name: reembed
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a candidate-model refresh, paired golden-query measurement of both generations, gating, activation recording and projection of the serving chunks.

nodes.name: rerank.py
nodes.summary: Reranker seam: a Voyage rerank-2.5 HTTP client with redaction, retries and cost tracking, a keyless lexical-overlap stand-in, and factories that pick a reranker from settings or by model name.

nodes.name: RerankHit
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of one rerank hit: candidate index and relevance score.

nodes.name: RerankResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of ranked hits with token usage and USD cost.

nodes.name: Reranker
nodes.summary: Protocol for rerankers: a model id and rerank(query, documents, top_k).

nodes.name: RerankUnavailable
nodes.summary: Retryable model error raised when the rerank provider is unreachable; callers keep the fused order.

nodes.name: VoyageReranker
nodes.summary: Voyage rerank client posting the redacted query and documents over httpx with retries, backoff and error-taxonomy mapping, returning hits sorted by relevance with cost.

nodes.name: LexicalOverlapReranker
nodes.summary: Deterministic offline reranker that scores candidates by query-term overlap.

nodes.name: build_reranker
nodes.summary: Returns None when reranking is off, a Voyage reranker when its key is set (after the opt-out check), else the lexical stand-in.

nodes.name: RerankModelUnavailable
nodes.summary: Error raised when a named reranker cannot be built because its provider key is missing.

nodes.name: reranker_for
nodes.summary: Builds a reranker by model name for comparisons ('none' for no reranker), never silently substituting.

nodes.name: make_distractors.py
nodes.summary: CLI script that installs (optionally after clearing) generated distractor chunks for one tenant, so the eval runner and CI can seed distractors without the ccp CLI.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses --tenant, --count and --clear, opens the app pool, scopes a database handle to the tenant and installs distractors with the configured embedder.

nodes.name: test_agent_role.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (MT3) proving agent tools read through a read-only, RLS-scoped database role: every tool works, writes and unread tables are refused, other tenants are invisible, and the catalogue lint flags a granted write.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that prepares the acme tenant, indexes it, runs tier-1 evaluations and state writes, and yields a ScopedDB on the agent read-only pool.

nodes.name: test_every_tool_works_through_the_read_only_role
nodes.summary: Binds every tool spec on the read-only role and calls each with real ids, allowing only a not-found investigation lookup as an error.

nodes.name: test_the_read_only_role_cannot_write_and_sees_one_tenant
nodes.summary: Asserts INSERT, UPDATE and reads of tables no tool uses raise InsufficientPrivilege, and that the role sees only its own tenant's verdicts.

nodes.name: test_the_lint_fails_when_the_agent_role_is_given_a_write
nodes.summary: Temporarily grants INSERT on verdicts to the agent role and asserts the catalogue lint reports it.

nodes.name: test_checkpoint_rls.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S14) that agent checkpoint tables sit under row-level security on thread_id, that every minted thread id is tenant-prefixed, and that saver sessions set the tenant per transaction.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes both tenants and runs a stubbed tier-3 HR-4 agent evaluation per tenant to populate checkpoints.

nodes.name: test_every_minted_thread_id_starts_with_the_tenant
nodes.summary: Checks that thread_id_for prefixes the tenant and tenant_of_thread parses it back.

nodes.name: test_raw_read_of_another_tenants_thread_is_empty_and_unscoped_raises
nodes.summary: Verifies on a raw connection that each checkpoint table returns only the session tenant's threads and that an unset tenant raises.

nodes.name: test_saver_sessions_carry_the_schema_and_each_transaction_the_tenant
nodes.summary: Verifies the checkpoint saver pool sets the search path but no session tenant, refuses unscoped reads, and sees only the tenant set per transaction.

nodes.name: test_citations.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S3) that model citations are verified after generation: fabricated chunk ids and absent quotes are dropped, minor punctuation differences are tolerated, and a verdict left with no verified citation becomes needs_review.

nodes.name: test_a_fabricated_chunk_id_is_dropped
nodes.summary: Asserts verify_fields drops a citation to an unknown chunk id and nulls the field it supported.

nodes.name: test_a_quote_absent_from_the_chunk_is_dropped
nodes.summary: Asserts a quote absent from the real chunk is dropped and its field nulled while a valid citation survives.

nodes.name: test_a_dropped_comma_is_tolerated_but_a_different_sentence_is_not
nodes.summary: Checks quote_supported tolerates punctuation, case and whitespace differences but rejects a different sentence.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes acme and yields tier-2 providers backed by a citation-fabricating stub LLM.

nodes.name: test_a_verdict_whose_only_citations_are_dropped_becomes_needs_review
nodes.summary: Runs tier-2 GH-4 against fabricated citations and asserts needs_review status, no verified citations, both citation guardrail events and reduced confidence.

nodes.name: test_copilot_isolation.py
nodes.summary: Security test (S9) that the acme Copilot, asked about Globex, searches only acme chunks, names no Globex-only data and answers that it has no data.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes both tenants and yields stub Copilot providers.

nodes.name: test_acme_copilot_has_no_data_about_globex
nodes.summary: Asks the acme Copilot about Globex and asserts the search returned no Globex chunks, the answer is the no-data reply without Globex-only tokens, and the thread id is acme-prefixed.

nodes.name: test_graphs_are_read_only.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S10) that every agent graph's allowlisted tools are in the read-only tool registry and that drafting and approving a policy changes no evidence or chunks.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes acme and yields providers backed by stub policy-graph handlers.

nodes.name: test_every_allowlisted_tool_is_in_the_read_only_registry
nodes.summary: Asserts every graph allowlist is a subset of the read-only tool specs and tool functions.

nodes.name: test_a_draft_changes_no_evidence_and_neither_does_approving_it
nodes.summary: Drafts a policy for CTL-VULN-DISCLOSURE, approves it, and asserts evidence and chunk counts are unchanged and no draft became evidence.

nodes.name: test_investigator_actions.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S12) that Investigator proposals are bounded to the closed action catalogue: an off-catalogue action fails schema validation and is dropped with a guardrail event, writing no proposal row or remediation approval.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes acme and runs HR-1 evaluations with an Investigator stub that proposes an off-catalogue action.

nodes.name: test_the_schema_itself_rejects_an_off_catalogue_action
nodes.summary: Asserts the investigation draft schema raises ValidationError for an action outside the closed catalogue.

nodes.name: test_an_off_catalogue_proposal_is_dropped_and_no_proposal_row_is_written
nodes.summary: Investigates Jane's HR-1 verdict and asserts the investigation persists with no proposed actions, an action_rejected guardrail event, and no proposal or remediation approval rows.

nodes.name: test_prompt_injection.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S2, S16) that retrieved content is treated as data: an injected instruction in evidence is flagged and ignored, and a poisoned chunk carrying forged or replayed fence markers stays inside a fresh nonce fence without changing the verdict.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes both tenants and yields tier-2 providers with a stub extractor.

nodes.name: test_injected_instruction_ignored
nodes.summary: Evaluates Globex GH-4 with injected instructions in its evidence and asserts a capped confidence, an injection_marker_detected event, and that the strict judge's rubric criterion holds.

nodes.name: test_boundary_break
nodes.summary: Poisons an acme policy chunk with forged and replayed fence markers, re-evaluates GH-4, and asserts a fresh nonce, every fenced block uses it, the attack stays inside its block, and status and extracted fields match the control run.

nodes.name: test_tenant_isolation.py
nodes.summary: Security tests (S1, S5, S15) of tenant scoping: agent tools see only their tenant's chunks and reject a tenant argument, RLS holds on raw connections including vector search, thread ids guard tenant mismatches, empty tenants read as no_evaluations_yet, and no application SQL filters by tenant outside scoped.py.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module fixture that indexes both tenants and yields stub agent providers.

nodes.name: test_agent_cannot_reach_other_tenant
nodes.summary: Shows the Copilot's bound tools return only acme chunks for a Globex-seeded search, cannot fetch a real Globex chunk id, reject a tenant_id argument, and that a tier-3 verdict cites only acme chunks.

nodes.name: test_rls_holds_without_scoped_db
nodes.summary: Checks on a raw connection that RLS limits counts and pgvector nearest-neighbour results to the session tenant and that an unscoped session raises.

nodes.name: test_thread_id_tenant_guard
nodes.summary: Asserts a foreign tenant's thread id is refused by the CLI guard and by tier-3 resume and pending-payload lookups.

nodes.name: test_an_empty_tenant_reads_as_no_evaluations_yet
nodes.summary: Asserts a framework rollup for an unevaluated tenant reports no_evaluations_yet rather than an empty result.

nodes.name: test_no_tenant_predicate_in_sql_outside_scoped_py
nodes.summary: Scans application source for WHERE tenant_id predicates and fails on any file outside the allowed scoped, dispatch and partition modules.

nodes.name: test_upload_tenant.py
nodes.summary: Security test (S13) that a manual upload cannot claim another tenant: tenant claims in the manifest or front matter are ignored with guardrail events and the other tenant's evidence and index stay untouched.

nodes.name: test_an_upload_cannot_claim_another_tenant
nodes.summary: Lands an acme upload whose manifest and front matter claim Globex, then asserts the evidence is acme's, both claim-ignored guardrail events were logged, and Globex's evidence and chunk count are unchanged.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the agent graph declarations built over the shared agent core: the tier-3 evaluator, Investigator, policy and Copilot graphs.

nodes.name: stops.py
nodes.summary: Operator-requested run stopping: a stop request is a tenant-scoped row in run_stops that the run's budget tracker polls at every node boundary and tool call, so a run cancels itself without depending on the agent's cooperation.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Typer command for the Compliance Copilot (`ccp copilot`): an interactive REPL or single-shot --ask mode that streams answers, prints cited quotes, sanitizes terminal output, and opens approval items only after explicit confirmation.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Copilot session runner (spec Layer 17): each REPL session is one checkpointed agent thread whose turns run the copilot graph with allowlisted read-only tools, persist a CopilotAnswer, validate requested actions against tenant data, and open remediation proposals with approval items only after the operator confirms.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses frozen dataclasses as immutable per-turn records and a context-manager Session so connection pools are always closed; the daily-budget ParkedError is caught to degrade to a model-free answer instead of failing the turn.

nodes.name: streaming.py
nodes.summary: Streams the `text` field of a structured-output JSON answer token by token, so the terminal shows the Copilot's prose while citations and requested actions are still generating; also records first-token latency.
nodes.languageNotes: Decodes a partial JSON string literal by trimming incomplete \u escapes and unpaired high surrogates before json.loads, emitting only the newly decoded suffix.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Inserts an idempotent stop request for a thread into run_stops and returns False when the run was already asked to stop.

nodes.name: requested
nodes.summary: Returns who asked a run to stop, or None, by reading run_stops for the thread.

nodes.name: watcher
nodes.summary: Builds a zero-argument callback that polls for a stop request on a thread, handed to the run's budget tracker.

nodes.name: printable
nodes.summary: Strips ANSI CSI/OSC escape sequences and C0 controls from model output and evidence quotes so a document cannot retitle the terminal or write the clipboard.

nodes.name: _turn
nodes.summary: Runs one Copilot turn in the terminal: streams tokens, prints the final answer and citations, reports rejected actions, previews pending actions and opens approval items on confirmation.

nodes.name: copilot
nodes.summary: CLI entry for `ccp copilot`: resolves tenant, settings and providers, requires an LLM key, opens a runner Session on the app pool and runs a single-shot or REPL loop.

nodes.name: PendingAction
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a requested remediation action whose target resolved against the tenant's data but is not yet opened.

nodes.name: Turn
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one Copilot turn: the persisted answer, pending actions, rejected guardrail events and node trajectory.

nodes.name: Opened
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the approval, proposal and investigation ids created when an operator confirms a turn.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Renders a plain-text preview of exactly which approval items a confirmation would open, with reversibility and the verdict each fixes.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: One tenant's Copilot session bound to a checkpoint thread: builds the graph with budgeted model deps and gated tools, enforces the daily budget with a model-free rollup fallback, validates actions via target resolution, and on confirm runs the Investigator if needed before opening remediation approvals.

nodes.name: _unescaped_quote
nodes.summary: Returns the index of the first unescaped double quote in a raw JSON string fragment, skipping backslash escapes.

nodes.name: TextFieldStreamer
nodes.summary: Buffers streamed JSON deltas, locates the `text` key, safely decodes the partial string literal and emits only newly decoded prose to a callback while timing the first token.

nodes.name: capture.py
nodes.summary: Implements `ccp evals capture <trace_id>`: turns an eval.<target> step from the step log into an exact-graded golden case appended to evals/golden/captured.yaml, dropping volatile model prose and noting replay material such as chunk ids, fence nonces and prompt versions.

nodes.name: budget_gate.py
nodes.summary: Tenant daily model budget (spec A-11): records spend in an append-only spend_ledger and parks evaluation records with ParkedError once a tenant's spend for the UTC day reaches its cap.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Clock producer (spec D11): a scheduled pass that enqueues re-evaluations for subjects whose latest verdict is older than the test's revalidate_every or whose newest cited evidence exceeds evidence_max_age, tagging each with its staleness reason.

nodes.name: evidence_cli.py
nodes.summary: Typer sub-app `ccp evidence` for uploads: show feedback on an evidence entity, drain queued adequacy-verifier jobs, record an auditor's accept/flag label, and report the verifier's calibration against auditors.

nodes.name: feedback.py
nodes.summary: Immediate feedback on uploaded evidence (spec A-161): an ordered consumer of the entities topic that stores segments and code-based admissibility checks as evidence_feedback rows and queues one adequacy-verifier job per upload version, with no model call.

nodes.name: find_step
nodes.summary: Scans the step log for an eval.<target> step by step id, or the last one of a run id, and returns it with offloaded blobs resolved.

nodes.name: expectation_from
nodes.summary: Turns an observed output into a $subset expectation without volatile keys, relaxing confidence to a lower bound.

nodes.name: case_from_step
nodes.summary: Builds a component-level GoldenCase from an eval step, with replay material (chunk ids, nonce, prompt and schema versions) recorded in its notes and customer origin.

nodes.name: append_case
nodes.summary: Appends a golden case to the captured YAML file unless its id already exists, and returns the file path.

nodes.name: capture
nodes.summary: Top-level capture: finds the step for a trace id, builds the golden case and appends it, raising LookupError when no eval step matches.

nodes.name: record_spend
nodes.summary: Appends a positive USD/token spend entry for the tenant to the spend_ledger.

nodes.name: daily_spend
nodes.summary: Sums the tenant's ledger spend within the current UTC day window.

nodes.name: check_daily_budget
nodes.summary: Returns today's spend or raises ParkedError when the tenant has reached its daily_budget_usd cap.

nodes.name: ClockSummary
nodes.summary: Counter of how many evaluations a clock tick enqueued, broken down by staleness reason.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: One clock pass for a tenant: walks every test's latest verdicts and enqueues a re-evaluation when the revalidation interval has passed or cited evidence is stale.

nodes.name: ClockProducer
nodes.summary: Worker-loop adapter registered as `clock` that runs one tick per run_once on the evaluations topic.

nodes.name: show_feedback
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evidence feedback`: drains pending feedback and prints the newest feedback rows for an evidence entity, optionally including shadow answers.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evidence verify`: drains feedback then runs queued adequacy-verifier jobs and prints how many were verified.

nodes.name: label
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evidence label`: records an auditor's accept-or-flag decision on the newest version of a document.

nodes.name: calibrate
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evidence calibrate`: prints the adequacy verifier's calibration against auditor labels and exits 1 while it may not be shown.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Inserts one evidence_feedback row (kind, admissibility, badge, reasons, text digest, latency) for an evidence version and returns its id.

nodes.name: give
nodes.summary: Records segments and code-based admissibility feedback for one document version exactly once.

nodes.name: latest
nodes.summary: Returns the newest feedback of each kind for an evidence entity as the uploader sees it, optionally including shadow rows.

nodes.name: queue_adequacy
nodes.summary: Appends one adequacy-verifier job per upload version to the adequacy topic unless one is already queued.

nodes.name: EvidenceFeedback
nodes.summary: Ordered consumer of the entities topic, registered as `evidence-feedback`, that gives feedback and queues adequacy for every new version of an uploaded document.

nodes.name: drain
nodes.summary: Runs the EvidenceFeedback consumer until caught up and returns how many feedback rows it gave.

nodes.name: impact.py
nodes.summary: Impact step (spec Layer 7 trigger): maps an entity change to the (test, subject) evaluations it affects using the data-driven knowledge/impact.yaml rule table, and enqueues them on the evaluations topic coalesced per subject in a 60-second window.
nodes.languageNotes: Impact rules are pydantic models with a model_validator that checks every condition and subject against a closed vocabulary at load time, so the YAML cannot ask for anything the code cannot answer.

nodes.name: jobs.py
nodes.summary: Scheduled-jobs consumer (spec A-108): a parallel consumer of the jobs topic that dispatches each fired schedule slot to a named, idempotent job (clock, unpark, full_run, connection checks, sync, replay sentinel, audit checkpoint/verify, transcribe), one run at a time per schedule.

nodes.name: second_reader.py
nodes.summary: Second reader on AI-derived PASS verdicts (spec A-143): a separate model checks whether each verified quote supports its extracted value, and a disagreement downgrades the PASS to needs_review with a capped confidence.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for ingestion (spec Layer 2): immutable raw zone, event log, consumers and worker loop.

nodes.name: consumers.py
nodes.summary: Consumer base classes for the Postgres event-log queue: OrderedConsumer reads a topic by seq cursor in one transaction with per-consumer retry and dead-lettering, while ParallelConsumer claims rows under heartbeat-renewed leases and runs handlers (including model calls) outside transactions; also defines the retry/throttle/terminal/parked error taxonomy.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ABC abstract handlers plus a daemon heartbeat thread (LeaseKeeper) and lease tokens to fence stale workers, so a worker that lost its lease can no longer move a record.

nodes.name: EvaluationRequest
nodes.summary: Frozen (test, subject) evaluation request with its trigger time and reason, serializable to and from an event-log ref.

nodes.name: enqueue
nodes.summary: Appends an evaluation record or folds it into a pending one for the same (tenant, test, subject) inside the coalescing window, carrying the latest trigger time.

nodes.name: _group_is_terminated
nodes.summary: Reports whether any HRIS person in a canonical identity group is terminated in its newest known employment status.

nodes.name: ImpactRule
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for one impact-table rule (table, conditions, tests, subject) validated against the closed condition and subject vocabulary.

nodes.name: load_table
nodes.summary: Loads knowledge/impact.yaml into validated ImpactRule tuples and rejects rules naming tests unknown to the catalogue.

nodes.name: _Change
nodes.summary: Lazily reads one changed row and answers the rule conditions and subject lookups (canonical person, repository, tenant) the impact table asks about.

nodes.name: requests_for_entity
nodes.summary: Applies the impact table to one entity change and returns the evaluation requests whose rule conditions hold.

nodes.name: parse_entity_ref
nodes.summary: Extracts (table, entity_id) from an entities-topic record, taking the entity id from the partition key because ids contain colons.

nodes.name: ImpactConsumer
nodes.summary: Ordered consumer registered as `impact` that maps entities-topic changes to coalesced evaluations-topic records under a traced step.

nodes.name: JobsConsumer
nodes.summary: Parallel consumer of the jobs topic with one run per schedule key that looks up the named job, runs it under a traced step and treats unknown jobs as terminal errors.

nodes.name: SecondRead
nodes.summary: Structured output of the second reader: whether it agrees and a short reason.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Asks a second model whether verified quotes support the extracted field values of a tier 2/3 PASS, records the spend, and downgrades the verdict to needs_review on disagreement.

nodes.name: RetryableError
nodes.summary: Transient handler error: the record returns to pending after a backoff until max_attempts, then dead-letters.

nodes.name: ThrottledError
nodes.summary: Provider throttle (429/529/503): the record waits without spending an attempt.

nodes.name: TerminalError
nodes.summary: Permanent handler error: the record dead-letters on first occurrence.

nodes.name: ParkedError
nodes.summary: Signals that a record must park (e.g. tenant budget exhausted) without counting an attempt.

nodes.name: OrderedConsumer
nodes.summary: Abstract ordered-topic consumer: under a try-lock reads records after its seq cursor sorted by (source_ts, seq), handles each in a savepoint, tracks per-consumer failures with backoff and dead-lettering, and supports replay of dead records.

nodes.name: worker_identity
nodes.summary: Returns host:pid identifying the lease holder for operators reading event_log.

nodes.name: LeaseKeeper
nodes.summary: Context manager running a daemon heartbeat thread that renews a worker's held leases every third of the lease length and reports leases lost to another worker.

nodes.name: ParallelConsumer
nodes.summary: Abstract parallel-topic consumer that claims rows under leases (with optional per-tenant caps and one-per-key ordering), handles them outside transactions under a LeaseKeeper, and moves each to done, retry, deferred, parked or dead.

nodes.name: dispatch.py
nodes.summary: Work hints (spec A-106): a work_hints table telling workers which tenants a consumer may have work for, with fair longest-ago-served claiming, held hints, release and next-due computation so one tenant's backlog cannot starve others.

nodes.name: event_log.py
nodes.summary: The event_log table as a Kafka-style queue: appends with per-(tenant, topic) seq numbering for ordered topics, cursors, lease-based parallel claims with renewal and token-fenced status transitions, exponential backoff, parking, dead letters, per-consumer ordered failures and replay records.
nodes.languageNotes: All functions take an open psycopg cursor so row-level security scopes every statement to the transaction's tenant; SKIP LOCKED claims and advisory transaction locks provide concurrency control.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: Operator actions on the queue (spec A-97): list parallel and ordered dead letters, replay a dead record (requeue or re-run by each ordered consumer that dead-lettered it) with an audit row, and unpark parked records.

nodes.name: schedules.py
nodes.summary: Per-tenant wall-clock schedules (spec A-108): syncs configured schedules into a table, computes next slots for `every N minutes|hours` and DST-aware `daily HH:MM`, and fires each due slot exactly once onto the jobs topic, folding missed slots after an outage.

nodes.name: topics.py
nodes.summary: Topic registry declaring each event-log topic as ordered or parallel, which decides the consumer class that reads it.

nodes.name: Claimed
nodes.summary: Frozen claimed work hint: the tenant and when the hold expires.

nodes.name: mark_ready
nodes.summary: Marks a consumer's hints ready now for the given tenants, including held hints so a notification during service is never lost.

nodes.name: claim
nodes.summary: Claims the ready hint served longest ago and holds it for a fixed period, giving fair round-robin across tenants.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Returns a held hint with its next due time unless a notification marked it ready while held.

nodes.name: seconds_to_next
nodes.summary: Computes how long until the consumer's next hint falls due, or None when all hints are idle.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Issues pg_notify on the ccp_work channel so a topic's workers wake when the transaction commits.

nodes.name: try_lock
nodes.summary: Takes a non-blocking transaction-scoped advisory lock on a key, returning False if another holder has it.

nodes.name: backoff_seconds
nodes.summary: Computes capped exponential backoff with up to 50% random jitter for retry n+1.

nodes.name: LogRecord
nodes.summary: Frozen event-log row (offset, tenant, topic, partition key, source time, ref, status, attempts, seq, lease token) built from a database row.

nodes.name: _next_seq
nodes.summary: Advances and locks the (tenant, topic) seq counter so ordered-topic numbers become visible in commit order.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends one record to event_log, assigning the next seq on ordered topics and notifying the topic's workers at commit; returns its offset.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Fetches one event-log record by offset.

nodes.name: fetch_after
nodes.summary: Returns the tenant's next records on an ordered topic after a seq, in seq order.

nodes.name: committed_seq
nodes.summary: Returns the highest committed seq of the tenant's topic, or 0 when empty.

nodes.name: read_cursor
nodes.summary: Reads the last seq a consumer completed on a topic.

nodes.name: advance_cursor
nodes.summary: Upserts a consumer's cursor to a new seq on a topic.

nodes.name: claim
nodes.summary: Claims up to a limit of due records (pending past their wait, or with expired leases) using SKIP LOCKED, issuing fresh lease tokens and optionally enforcing one claim per partition key.

nodes.name: claim_offset
nodes.summary: Claims one named record if it is due and unheld, letting the process that queued a job be its first worker.

nodes.name: live_claims
nodes.summary: Counts the tenant's records on a topic held under a live lease.

nodes.name: lock
nodes.summary: Takes a blocking transaction-scoped advisory lock on a key.

nodes.name: waiting_on_key
nodes.summary: Reports whether another record with the same partition key is pending behind a record.

nodes.name: renew
nodes.summary: Pushes the given leases forward by offset and token and returns the offsets still held.

nodes.name: _transition
nodes.summary: Moves a record to a new status and releases its lease, only while the presented lease token still holds it.

nodes.name: mark_done
nodes.summary: Marks a claimed record done under its lease token.

nodes.name: mark_retry
nodes.summary: Returns a failed record to pending after a backoff, recording the error, under its lease token.

nodes.name: mark_deferred
nodes.summary: Defers a throttled record to pending after a wait and gives the claim's attempt back.

nodes.name: deferrals_of
nodes.summary: Returns how many times a record has been deferred.

nodes.name: mark_parked
nodes.summary: Parks a record until unparked, giving back the attempt since a park is not a failed try.

nodes.name: mark_dead
nodes.summary: Dead-letters a parallel record with its last error under its lease token.

nodes.name: requeue_dead
