nodes.name: test_the_saver_scopes_each_statement_by_a_transaction_local_tenant
nodes.summary: Asserts the saver connection string carries no tenant, a scoped get_tuple runs, and no app.tenant_id lingers on the pooled connection afterwards.

nodes.name: test_two_workers.py
nodes.summary: Workflow test that a parallel-topic record claimed by a killed worker is reclaimed after the visibility timeout and completed exactly once by a second worker subprocess.

nodes.name: own_db
nodes.summary: Fixture giving the test its own migrated scratch database, skipping when Postgres is unreachable.

nodes.name: test_killed_worker_is_reclaimed_and_the_record_completes_once
nodes.summary: Appends an evaluations record, starts a slow worker subprocess that claims it and kills it, then runs a second worker after the claim expires and asserts one effect line and a done status after two attempts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the connector layer (spec Layer 1); its docstring states the contract that provider data comes in and leaves as SourceEvents with payloads untouched.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for AWS evidence collection, documenting the external-ID onboarding of a customer's read-only role (A-139) and the connector that reads configuration through it (A-140).

nodes.name: connector.py
nodes.summary: AWS connector that assumes the customer's onboarded read-only role and snapshots the account's S3 public-access block and CloudTrail trails, every S3 bucket's effective block, and IAM users (console access, MFA), preferring AWS Config's inventory and keeping each raw response with its request id. Also provides Config history, CloudTrail lookups and resource-inventory reads used to investigate failing resources.
nodes.languageNotes: Registers a botocore 'after-call.*.*' event hook on every boto3 client to capture raw response bytes without wrapping each API call.

nodes.name: effective
nodes.summary: Computes the S3 public-access block that S3 actually enforces: each flag holds when either the account-level or the bucket-level block sets it.

nodes.name: AwsConnector
nodes.summary: Live AWS connector that assumes the onboarded role with CCP's external ID, captures every botocore response, and yields content-addressed snapshot events for the account, each S3 bucket and each IAM user while marking scopes in the SyncReport. Also offers the daily role check, AWS Config history reads and CloudTrail event lookups.

nodes.name: windows
nodes.summary: Cuts a time range into consecutive 7-day windows, the span AWS Config history answers at a time.

nodes.name: inventory_of
nodes.summary: Lists every resource AWS Config records in the account (type, id, name, region) through paginated SELECT queries, returning None when no recorder is recording so a partial inventory is never read as whole.

nodes.name: resource_config
nodes.summary: Fetches one resource's current configuration and supplementary configuration as recorded by AWS Config, parsing embedded JSON; returns None when Config has no record.

nodes.name: onboarding.py
nodes.summary: AWS account onboarding: generates a per-account external ID, builds the CloudFormation quick-create URL, and verifies the customer's role (assumable only with the external ID, no ReadOnlyAccess attached, write and secret-reading actions simulated as denied) to prevent confused-deputy access.

nodes.name: Sts
nodes.summary: Protocol for the slice of the STS client onboarding uses: assume_role.

nodes.name: Iam
nodes.summary: Protocol for the IAM client calls onboarding needs: listing attached role policies and simulating principal policies.

nodes.name: Verification
nodes.summary: Frozen result of an onboarding check: account id, role ARN and findings; ok when there are no findings.

nodes.name: new_external_id
nodes.summary: Generates a random, unguessable external ID prefixed 'ccp-' for one account's role trust policy.

nodes.name: check_account_id
nodes.summary: Validates that an AWS account id is exactly 12 digits, raising ValueError otherwise.

nodes.name: quick_create_url
nodes.summary: Builds the CloudFormation console quick-create link that deploys the CCPReadOnly stack with CCP's external ID and principal as parameters.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Verifies an onboarded role: it must be in the stated account, assumable with the external ID but not without it, have no ReadOnlyAccess attached, and every action in MUST_BE_DENIED must simulate as denied; each failure becomes a finding.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the connector contract: the SourceEvent model keyed by the provider's own event id and timestamp, the Connector protocol, PullError kinds, versioned Connection records, and the SyncReport that marks each declared scope complete, partial, not visible or failed. Also holds shared timestamp-parsing, hashing, JSON-loading and since-filter helpers.

nodes.name: PullError
nodes.summary: Exception for a pull that cannot go on, carrying a kind (auth, not_visible or fail) that the sync run records.

nodes.name: Connection
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one declared, versioned connection: a connector reading one provider account, with its credential purpose name, enabled flag and non-secret params such as an AWS role ARN and external ID.

nodes.name: ScopeOutcome
nodes.summary: Frozen outcome of one scope in a pull: status, item count and optional detail.

nodes.name: SyncReport
nodes.summary: Records what one pull saw scope by scope, rejecting undeclared scopes, treating unreached scopes as failed, and deriving the run status (complete, partial or failed).

nodes.name: Received
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one raw provider response (method, path, status, request id, body bytes, receipt time) with its SHA-256 digest, kept in the raw zone beside the events made from it.

nodes.name: SourceEvent
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model of one provider event (tenant, connector, provider event id, timezone-aware provider timestamp normalized to UTC, type, untouched payload, schema version) with a dedup key of tenant, connector and provider id.

nodes.name: Connector
nodes.summary: Structural protocol every connector satisfies: a name, source kind, declared scopes and a pull method that yields SourceEvents and marks a SyncReport.

nodes.name: parse_ts
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO 8601 timestamp (a trailing Z means UTC), rejecting naive values and returning UTC.

nodes.name: sha256_bytes
nodes.summary: Returns the hex SHA-256 digest of raw bytes.

nodes.name: sha256_json
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 digest of an object's canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators).

nodes.name: load_json
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a UTF-8 JSON file.

nodes.name: after
nodes.summary: Filters an event iterator to the events whose provider timestamp is strictly later than an optional since cutoff.

nodes.name: conformance.py
nodes.summary: Connector conformance harness that runs recorded offline scenarios through each live connector and checks the sync contract (run status, hidden scopes never complete, named PullError kinds, well-formed events, stable re-pull ids, honoured rate-limit waits, secret-free recordings), plus negative controls that must fail to prove the harness is not blind.

nodes.name: Expect
nodes.summary: Frozen expectation for a scenario: the run status or the PullError kind it stops with, per-scope statuses, and rate-limit waits that must happen.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Frozen description of one conformance scenario: name, description, expectations, listings hidden from the credential, whether a re-pull must yield the same snapshots, and an optional extra check.

nodes.name: Suite
nodes.summary: Protocol a connector conformance suite implements: build a connector for a scenario, say which listings a pull settled, expose recordings for the secret scan, and clean up.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one scenario with its problems; passed when there are none.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: A negative control: a name, the promise it breaks, and a suite whose connector breaks it; it must fail.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Aggregate harness report of scenario and control results; lists controls the harness wrongly passed as blind and is green only when every scenario passes and no control is blind.

nodes.name: unsafe
nodes.summary: Scans recording text against credential patterns (GitHub tokens, AWS key ids, Authorization or Bearer headers, private keys) and returns the patterns found.

nodes.name: harness_tenant
nodes.summary: Builds the synthetic 'conformance' tenant context a suite runs under when no tenant is given.

nodes.name: _pull
nodes.summary: Runs one scenario's connector pull, collecting events, the SyncReport, the PullError kind it stopped with and recorded sleeps, and flags a stop that raised anything other than a PullError.

nodes.name: run_scenario
nodes.summary: Checks one scenario's pull against its expectations: stop kind, run status, scope statuses, no settled listing that was hidden, tenant-correct well-formed events, honoured waits, custom checks, and identical snapshot ids on an unchanged re-pull.

nodes.name: run_suite
nodes.summary: Runs every scenario of a suite plus a secret scan of its recordings, always closing the suite afterwards.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs every suite and then every negative control with connector logging quieted, returning the Report.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Returns the GitHub and manual-upload suites and their negative controls, imported lazily.

nodes.name: frontmatter.py
nodes.summary: Small helper that splits YAML front matter from Markdown or text documents, returning the parsed mapping and the body.

nodes.name: split_front_matter
nodes.summary: Normalizes line endings and splits a leading '---' YAML block from the body, returning ({}, text) when there is none and raising when the front matter is not a mapping.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the GitHub connector, which offers a fixture reader by default and a live REST/GraphQL client with --source live.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: Live GitHub connector that reads the organization, members (with verified domain emails over GraphQL), repositories, collaborators, branch protection, SECURITY.md and file listings, emitting the same event shapes as the fixture reader. It applies the per-endpoint error table, retries with backoff, per-tenant rate buckets, content-derived snapshot ids, per-scope sync reporting and a final org.pull.completed settlement marker, and exposes a code-search lookup for failing resources.

nodes.name: GitHubPullError
nodes.summary: PullError for a GitHub pull that cannot be trusted: retries that did not clear an error, or a response the error table says stops the pull.

nodes.name: Gap
nodes.summary: Enum telling a read with no body apart: ABSENT is a fact, NOT_VISIBLE is a gap that leaves its scope partial.

nodes.name: content_id
nodes.summary: Derives a stable event id from a prefix and a SHA-256 of the canonical payload without pull-time fields, so unchanged content pulled again lands nothing; reused by the AWS and Okta connectors.

nodes.name: GitHubLiveConnector
nodes.summary: Live GitHub API connector: makes bucket-limited requests with retries and error-table classification, paginates listings while recording visibility gaps, looks up verified emails over GraphQL, emits content-addressed org, member, repository and settings snapshots, marks each scope in the SyncReport, and ends with an org.pull.completed settlement marker.

nodes.name: search_code
nodes.summary: Code-search lookup for a failing resource: searches the organization's repositories for a term in files of a given extension under a dedicated search rate bucket, and returns each hit's decoded text.

nodes.name: conformance.py
nodes.summary: Conformance suite for the live GitHub connector: an httpx MockTransport recording of a synthetic organization, thirteen scenarios (page boundaries, credential and SSO refusals, rate limits, hidden listings, server errors, timeouts, plan-restricted settings, empty repositories), and three negative-control subclasses that each break one sync promise.

nodes.name: Recording
nodes.summary: Dataclass that simulates GitHub's API for a synthetic organization (members, repositories, collaborators, protection, SECURITY.md, files) as an httpx handler, with per-path overrides for scenarios and a dump of all bodies and headers for the secret scan.

nodes.name: _all_members_seen
nodes.summary: Builds a scenario check asserting the pull's completion marker lists the expected number of members and first-repository collaborators across page boundaries.

nodes.name: scenarios
nodes.summary: Defines the GitHub conformance scenarios, each paired with a Recording factory: normal and empty organizations, page boundaries, credential and SSO refusals, rate limits, hidden listings, server errors, timeouts, and plan-restricted settings.

nodes.name: Suite
nodes.summary: GitHub conformance suite: builds the live connector (or a broken subclass) over a mock transport per scenario and reports which listings a pull settled from its completion marker.

nodes.name: _HiddenReadAsEmpty
nodes.summary: Negative-control connector that reads a hidden listing as empty and drops the gap, the defect that would revoke every member when a token lost access.

nodes.name: _CompleteOverGaps
nodes.summary: Negative-control connector that marks every scope complete whatever it saw.

nodes.name: _IdsFromThePullTime
nodes.summary: Negative-control connector that stamps snapshot ids with a per-pull value, so an unchanged re-pull lands everything again.

nodes.name: controls
nodes.summary: Returns the three GitHub negative controls, each wrapping a broken connector subclass in a Suite.

nodes.name: errors.py
nodes.summary: Per-endpoint GitHub error table that maps each HTTP status on each endpoint to a meaning (ok, absent, not_visible, retry, rate_limited, auth, fail), so the client acts on meaning rather than raw status and an unknown 4xx is never read as an absence.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Frozen error-table rule mapping an endpoint (or any endpoint) and a status, optionally matched on a message substring, to a meaning and its reason.

nodes.name: is_rate_limit
nodes.summary: Detects GitHub rate limiting: HTTP 429, or 403 with no remaining quota or a Retry-After header.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Returns the meaning and reason of one response on one endpoint: 2xx is ok, rate limits come first, then the first matching table rule, then retry for 5xx, auth for 401, and fail otherwise.

nodes.name: fixture.py
nodes.summary: GitHub fixture connector that reads per-tenant JSON fixtures and emits the same org, member, repository, branch-protection, security-policy, file-listing and webhook-delivery events as the live client, with updated_at-based snapshot ids. Also provides a test-only overlay connector and apply_proposal to simulate a remediation that removes a collaborator or member.

nodes.name: load_docs
nodes.summary: Loads the seven GitHub fixture JSON documents (org, members, repos, branch protection, security policies, file listings, deliveries) from a directory.

nodes.name: GitHubFixtureConnector
nodes.summary: Fixture-backed GitHub connector that turns a tenant's fixture documents into snapshot and webhook-delivery SourceEvents shaped like the live client's, reporting every scope complete.

nodes.name: OverlayGitHubFixtureConnector
nodes.summary: Test-only fixture connector that serves an in-memory, mutated copy of one tenant's documents and reads other tenants from disk.

nodes.name: apply_proposal
nodes.summary: Test-only remediation simulation: deep-copies the fixture, removes a repository collaborator or organization member, bumps timestamps, appends the matching removal webhook delivery, and returns an overlay connector.

nodes.name: aggregator.py
nodes.summary: Live HRIS connector that pages Merge's HRIS employees API by cursor and maps each employee to the same hris.employee.snapshot shape the fixture lands, stopping the whole pull on any failed page so no verdict rests on a partial roster.

nodes.name: employee_payload
nodes.summary: Maps a Merge HRIS employee record into the fixture's employee shape, deriving the employee id, display name, terminated status (inactive with a termination date) and date fields.

nodes.name: HrisAggregatorConnector
nodes.summary: Live HRIS connector over Merge's API: pages employees by cursor, records each raw response, raises PullError on any non-200 page, and yields hris.employee.snapshot events.

nodes.name: fixture.py
nodes.summary: HRIS fixture connector that reads a tenant's employees, HR events, SSO identities, account registry, assets and front-matter Markdown documents from fixture files and emits typed hris.* SourceEvents, reporting every scope complete.

nodes.name: HrisFixtureConnector
nodes.summary: Reads a tenant's HRIS fixtures (employees, hire, role-change and termination events, identities, accounts, assets, front-matter documents) into hris.* SourceEvents, counting events per scope for the SyncReport.

nodes.name: okta.py
nodes.summary: Okta identity-provider connector that pages /api/v1/users through the Link header, reads each user's enrolled factors, and emits idp.user.snapshot events keyed by Okta's immutable user id with MFA status and content-derived ids.

nodes.name: OktaConnector
nodes.summary: Okta connector that authenticates with an SSWS token, pages users through Link headers, reads each user's factors, records raw responses, maps HTTP failures to PullError kinds, and yields idp.user.snapshot events with MFA status.

nodes.name: conformance.py
nodes.summary: Conformance suite for the manual upload connector: writes temporary tenant folders for five scenarios (normal, path escape, missing file, unsupported type, no manifest) and a negative control that claims the folder was read in full despite left-out entries.

nodes.name: scenarios
nodes.summary: Defines the five upload-folder conformance scenarios and their expected run and scope statuses.

nodes.name: Suite
nodes.summary: Upload conformance suite that writes each scenario's manifest and files under a temporary root, builds a live ManualUploadConnector over it, settles nothing, and removes the root on close.

nodes.name: _LeftOutIgnored
nodes.summary: Negative-control connector that marks the uploads scope complete regardless of the entries it left out.

nodes.name: controls
nodes.summary: Returns the upload connector's negative control wrapped in a Suite.

nodes.name: pdf_text.py
nodes.summary: Sandboxed PDF text extraction that runs pypdf in a capped child process (size, page count, timeout) and classifies the result (ok, too_large, timeout, unreadable, too_many_pages, no_text_layer); also splits blank pages into single-page PDFs for transcription and detects image types by magic bytes.
nodes.languageNotes: The module re-invokes itself with `python -m` as a subprocess, so a hostile PDF can only exhaust the caps and never hang the parent process.

nodes.name: PdfLimits
nodes.summary: Frozen caps for PDF handling (max bytes, max pages, timeout seconds), validated to be positive.

nodes.name: PdfExtraction
nodes.summary: Frozen extraction result with status, page count, per-page text and detail; text joins the pages.

nodes.name: extract_pages
nodes.summary: Extracts per-page text by running this module as a child process under size, page and time caps, classifying the outcome into a PdfExtraction status.

nodes.name: blank_pages
nodes.summary: Returns the 1-based numbers of pages that have no text layer.

nodes.name: image_type
nodes.summary: Detects PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP from the file's magic bytes, never from its name.

nodes.name: split_pages
nodes.summary: Splits the named pages of a PDF into single-page PDFs in a capped child process, for transcribing pages that have no text layer.

nodes.name: _split_child
nodes.summary: Child-process worker that uses pypdf to write each requested in-range page as its own base64-encoded PDF.

nodes.name: _child
nodes.summary: Child-process worker that reads a PDF with pypdf and returns its page count and per-page text when within the page cap.

nodes.name: uploads.py
nodes.summary: Manual upload connector that reads a tenant's upload folder through a required manifest, refuses entries that escape the folder, skips missing or unsupported files, extracts text from Markdown, text and PDF files, keeps scans (images or PDFs with blank pages) as raw bytes for transcription, and reports the uploads scope partial when anything was left out.

nodes.name: contained_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a manifest file name inside the tenant root, returning None for absolute, drive or parent-relative names and for anything that resolves outside the folder through links.

nodes.name: ManifestEntry
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of one manifest upload (file, evidence type, title, timezone-aware issued and uploaded times, optional subject employee) that keeps extra keys so the mapper can flag tenant claims.

nodes.name: Manifest
nodes.summary: Strict Pydantic model of an upload manifest: a list of ManifestEntry items and no other keys.

nodes.name: ManifestMissing
nodes.summary: PullError raised when a tenant's upload folder has no manifest, stopping the pull as a failure.

nodes.name: ManualUploadConnector
nodes.summary: Upload connector that validates the manifest, warns on stray files, emits manual.refused events for path escapes, reads Markdown and text front matter, PDFs (with capped extraction) and images, keeps scans as raw bytes for transcription, and marks the uploads scope partial when entries are left out.

nodes.name: rate.py
nodes.summary: Thread-safe token-bucket rate limiting keyed by (tenant, connection) with a process-wide registry, so all pulls on one connection share one budget and hold until the provider's quota reset once only a reserve remains.

nodes.name: RateBucket
nodes.summary: Thread-safe token bucket with steady refill up to a burst: take reserves a token under the lock and sleeps outside it, and observe holds the bucket until the provider's reset once the remaining quota falls to the reserve.

nodes.name: bucket_for
nodes.summary: Returns the single process-wide RateBucket for a (tenant, connection) pair, creating it on first use under a registry lock.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears every registered rate bucket, for tests and for a process that reloads its connections.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Connector factory: the single place a connector is chosen by name and source kind (fixture or live), wiring credentials, PDF limits, upload roots and AWS role sessions; also lists every connector's declared scopes.

nodes.name: declared_scopes
nodes.summary: Returns every scope each connector (fixture or live) can mark in a sync run, against which a test's required sources are validated.

nodes.name: pdf_limits
nodes.summary: Builds PdfLimits from the settings' PDF byte, page and timeout caps.

nodes.name: build_connector
nodes.summary: Factory returning the connector for a name and source kind: GitHub live or fixture, HRIS aggregator or fixture, manual uploads from the runtime or fixture root, AWS through an onboarded connection, or Okta; it resolves credentials and raises when a required one is missing.

nodes.name: _aws
nodes.summary: Builds an AwsConnector for a verified onboarded connection, with a boto3 client factory that uses the task role or the assumed-role session credentials.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: CopilotAnswer Pydantic record for one copilot turn (question, intent, answer text, verified citations, requested actions, model and guardrail metadata, latency) with tenant-scoped persistence to and loading from the copilot_answers table.

nodes.name: CopilotAnswer
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic record of one copilot turn: ids, tenant, thread and turn, question, intent, answer text, verified citations, requested actions, model and prompt version, guardrail events, latency metrics, fence nonce and raw request and response JSON.

nodes.name: persist
nodes.summary: Inserts a CopilotAnswer into copilot_answers through the tenant-scoped database, JSON-encoding citations, actions, guardrail events and raw payloads.

nodes.name: _from_row
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a CopilotAnswer from a copilot_answers row, decoding JSON columns and re-validating citations.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Loads one CopilotAnswer by answer id, or None when absent.

nodes.name: for_thread
nodes.summary: Loads every CopilotAnswer in a thread, ordered by turn.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the agent runtime (spec Layer 8): the shared core, read-only tools, per-graph allowlists and graphs; documents that graphs read while runners write, and that importing ccp.agent.tier3 registers the tier 3 evaluator.

nodes.name: allowlists.py
nodes.summary: Declares one tool allowlist per agent graph (tier3, investigator, task_item, policy, copilot) and the policy-pinned evidence tools, and refuses any graph that names an off-list tool at build time; each list also serves as its graph's base permit in the policy check.

nodes.name: authz.py
nodes.summary: Implements policy.check: a default-deny rule engine deciding permit, deny or ask for each principal, tool and validated arguments, built from the graph allowlists plus operator rules in config/tool_policy.yaml, with shadow log_only rules, a Rule of Two audit and a per-run Gate that logs every decision to policy_decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic rule models with an lru_cache-backed rule-file loader keyed on a file stamp; precedence is enforced deny, then ask, then permit, and anything unmatched or failing is a deny.

nodes.name: bundle.py
nodes.summary: Computes the release bundle hash: one SHA-256 over every prompt file, every tool's full contract, the fixed tool error texts, the allowlists and the policy rules, so eval runs, model calls and replays can name the exact bundle they ran.

nodes.name: check_allowlist
nodes.summary: Raises ToolNotAllowed when a graph is unknown or declares a tool outside its allowlist, enforcing per-graph tool restrictions at build time.

nodes.name: ToolNotAllowed
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a graph names a tool that is not on its allowlist.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for one policy rule (principal pattern, tools, effect, enforce or log_only mode, argument conditions) with methods that test whether it covers a principal and tool and whether its conditions match the call's arguments.

nodes.name: Decision
nodes.summary: Immutable result of a policy check: effect, deciding rule id, reason and any shadow log_only rule that would have permitted it; permitted is true only for an enforced permit.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.summary: Per-run (or per-API-caller) policy gateway that offers permitted tools, decides each call through check(), taints the run after untrusted reads to switch off act-class tools, and records every decision to policy_decisions, denying any call it cannot log.

nodes.name: base_rules
nodes.summary: Builds one enforced permit per graph principal from its allowlist, pinning the Policy Agent's evidence tools to policy documents.

nodes.name: rules
nodes.summary: Returns the base rules plus the operator's rule file, raising on a broken file so callers deny.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Decides a single tool call for a principal by rule precedence (enforced deny, ask, permit; default deny), never raising, since any failure becomes a deny, and noting shadow log_only permits.

nodes.name: offered
nodes.summary: Lists the tools some enforced permit could allow a principal, minus those an unconditional enforced deny takes away; a broken rule file offers none.

nodes.name: rule_of_two
nodes.summary: Audits the rule table against Meta's Rule of Two: flags any principal whose tools can read untrusted content and private data while also changing state with an act-class tool.

nodes.name: parts
nodes.summary: Assembles the named inputs to the bundle hash: prompt files by name and content, tool contracts, tool error texts, allowlists and policy rules.

nodes.name: bundle_sha256
nodes.summary: Cached SHA-256 digest over the bundle parts, stamped on every model call, the OpenAPI document and harness records.

nodes.name: core.py
nodes.summary: The shared agent core every graph is declared over: graph and node specs with mandatory retry and timeout policies, factories for structured extraction nodes, the bounded allowlisted tool loop with stop reasons and context ceilings, citation verification nodes and one-shot correction rounds, all wired to the run log, budget tracker and step log.
nodes.languageNotes: Closure-based node factories compile into a LangGraph StateGraph; every node carries a RetryPolicy, a soft timeout and budget accounting, and model requests are hashed into digests so the run log can serve them back on resume or replay.

nodes.name: copilot.py
nodes.summary: Declares the Compliance Copilot graph over the shared core: classify intent, gather through the copilot tool loop, answer as a CopilotAnswerDraft, then verify citations, enforce the status contract and bound requested actions. The graph has no write path; requested actions become approval items only after explicit confirmation.

nodes.name: investigator.py
nodes.summary: Declares the Investigator graph: load verdict and control context, gather through a bounded tool loop, diagnose the root cause as an InvestigationDraft, verify citations, bound proposed actions to the fix catalogue and correct once when a check fails, with computed confidence and no write path.

nodes.name: policy.py
nodes.summary: Declares the Policy Agent graph: load control text, gather only policy documents (search pinned to policy_document), analyze gaps into a GapReportDraft, verify citations, and in draft mode compose Markdown then scrub secrets and other tenants' names. It has no write tool.

nodes.name: NodePolicies
nodes.summary: Per-node retry policy (retryable errors only, bounded attempts with backoff) and timeout; default() supplies the standard policy every node must carry.

nodes.name: NodeSpec
nodes.summary: Declares one graph node: its name, function and mandatory NodePolicies.

nodes.name: GraphSpec
nodes.summary: Declarative graph definition (tools, nodes, edges, conditional edges, output schema) whose validate() enforces the graph's allowlist and requires policies on every node before build.

nodes.name: ModelDeps
nodes.summary: Model-call dependencies for one run (LLM client, model id, budget tracker, reasoning and stream flags, run-log database, replay source), with require() and a RunLog factory.

nodes.name: StopReason
nodes.summary: Enumerates why a tool loop ended (normal, refusal, truncation, repeated failures, calls or results, call cap); anything but normal holds the outcome for review.

nodes.name: Correction
nodes.summary: Describes how to ask one structured node again in a correction round: its prompt, schema meta, evidence selector, description and which typed failures it owns.

nodes.name: with_policies
nodes.summary: Wraps a node function with the budget clock, a step-log record, guardrail event logging and a soft per-node time limit.

nodes.name: build_graph
nodes.summary: Compiles a validated GraphSpec into a LangGraph StateGraph over AgentState with each node's retry policy, the edges and an optional checkpointer.

nodes.name: frame_state_chunks
nodes.summary: Fences retrieved evidence chunks under a nonce through the prompt guard, returning the framed text and the chunks actually shown to the model.

nodes.name: make_structured_node
nodes.summary: Factory for a structured-output node: loads the prompt, frames evidence under a fence nonce, fits the context ceiling, makes one schema-bound extraction through the run log (replayable by request digest) and returns raw fields, replay material and guardrail events.

nodes.name: model_stop
nodes.summary: Classifies the model's own ending of a tool-loop turn: a refusal, a truncated turn, or an answer without a tool call.

nodes.name: stop_reason
nodes.summary: Decides whether a tool loop must stop after a turn: three failures in a row, the same call or the same result three times, or the call cap.

nodes.name: _store_result
nodes.summary: Keeps an oversized tool result whole (redacted) in tool_results and returns the handle-plus-preview the model sees instead, keeping the context under its ceiling.

nodes.name: _extract_digest
nodes.summary: Hashes everything a structured call sends (schema, system, user text, documents, model, reasoning) into the run-log key used for resume and replay.

nodes.name: make_tool_loop
nodes.summary: Factory for the bounded tool loop: chats with the model over allowlisted bound tools, answers off-list or denied calls with error results and guardrail events, guards and fences tool output, offloads large results, enforces context ceilings and the call budget, and ends only through stop_reason.

nodes.name: verify_named_items
nodes.summary: Verifies list-valued extraction fields item by item ({name, citation}), dropping items whose chunk or quote fails, and returns verified names, citation records and events.

nodes.name: make_verify_node
nodes.summary: Factory for a pure citation-verification node over list-valued fields plus scalar cited fields (through the tier 2 verifier), recording schema failures and marking checks that fail after a correction.

nodes.name: schema_failures
nodes.summary: Collects the schema failures of the latest structured call of each node.

nodes.name: after_correction
nodes.summary: Marks a check that still fails after the correction round, so the graph holds the result for review instead of correcting again.

nodes.name: owned_by_fields
nodes.summary: Builds an ownership predicate that assigns a typed failure to a node when it names the node or one of its schema's fields.

nodes.name: make_correction_node
nodes.summary: Factory for the one-shot correction round: asks each owning structured node again with its typed failures and previous answer, replacing its raw output before the checks run again.

nodes.name: CopilotConfig
nodes.summary: Pydantic configuration for the copilot: maximum actions per turn, maximum tool calls and forbidden summary words.

nodes.name: enforce_status_contract
nodes.summary: Drops every sentence that uses a forbidden status word and returns the remaining text with the words found.

nodes.name: render_rollups
nodes.summary: Renders the deterministic status answer from the computed framework rollups, naming each requirement's blocking test.

nodes.name: _on_tool_result
nodes.summary: Records copilot tool results into state, keyed by tool and payload, so later nodes can reference this turn's chunks and results.

nodes.name: build_spec
nodes.summary: Builds the copilot GraphSpec for a tenant: classify, gather, answer and verify nodes over bound tools, with per-turn chunk scoping, citation checks, status-contract enforcement and catalogue-bounded requested actions.

nodes.name: _on_tool_result
nodes.summary: Accumulates chunks returned by investigator tool calls into graph state.

nodes.name: build_spec
nodes.summary: Builds the investigator GraphSpec: context loading, tool loop, structured diagnosis, citation verification, catalogue-bounded actions with fix parameter checks, correction routing and computed confidence.

nodes.name: scrub_text
nodes.summary: Removes secrets patterns, then other tenants' names (whole words, any case), from draft text, returning events that name each removed token only by hash.

nodes.name: build_spec
nodes.summary: Builds the policy GraphSpec: control loading, pinned tool loop, structured gap analysis, citation verification, optional Markdown compose and scrub nodes, and finalize with computed confidence.

nodes.name: task_item.py
nodes.summary: Declares the task item graph for the fan-out contract: one fresh run over one or a few items that loads typed facts, gathers read-only evidence, answers as ItemReadings, verifies item ids and claim quotes into evidence pointers under a token cap, and corrects once on failure.

nodes.name: tier3.py
nodes.summary: Declares tier 3 evaluation as a fixed workflow (fetch critical list, extract systems, fetch latest review, extract scope, verify citations, compare, gate, finalize) with a bounded search fallback, one correction round and a human-in-the-loop interrupt gate that fails closed.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses LangGraph interrupt() at the gate node; the decision is applied only through apply_decision, so a missing or malformed resume value can never approve a draft.

nodes.name: harness.py
nodes.summary: Harness metrics for agent runs: records one run_metrics row per finished run (stops, tool calls and errors, correction rounds, first-pass checks, context swaps, tokens and dollars, acceptance), reports rates per graph and bundle and fan-out stats per task kind, and gates a candidate bundle against a baseline.

nodes.name: rest.py
nodes.summary: REST surface generated from the tool registry: an OpenAPI document plus an in-process handler for GET /v1/tools and POST /v1/tools/{name} that sends calls through the same gateway, policy check, read-only role and output checks as agent calls, mapping outcomes to HTTP status codes.

nodes.name: _on_tool_result
nodes.summary: Collects chunks and verdict or control results from task-item tool calls into state for later verification.

nodes.name: pointer
nodes.summary: Turns a verified quote into a pointer with its evidence id, chunk id and document offsets when known.

nodes.name: check_readings
nodes.summary: The code checks between a run and a merge: rejects readings for unknown or duplicate items, drops claims whose quotes are not in their chunks, turns verified claims into pointers and trims readings over the result token cap.

nodes.name: _answer_lines
nodes.summary: Presents a person's answer as quoted untrusted data: redacted, stripped of invisible characters and withheld if it carries fence markers.

nodes.name: build_spec
nodes.summary: Builds the task_item GraphSpec: load context, gather, structured answer, verify and correction nodes over the task_item allowlist.

nodes.name: apply_decision
nodes.summary: Applies a reviewer decision to the draft verdict, failing closed: only a known action from a named reviewer changes anything, and anything else holds the draft as needs_review.

nodes.name: _fetch_newest
nodes.summary: Pure tool calls that fetch the newest evidence row of a type and every chunk of it, with no model involved.

nodes.name: measured_retrieval
nodes.summary: Computes retrieval quality from the weakest required evidence type: 1.0 when fetched directly, the calibrated quality of its best score when found by the search fallback, and 0 when not found.

nodes.name: _on_search_result
nodes.summary: Merges chunks returned by the fallback search loop into state per evidence type.

nodes.name: build_spec
nodes.summary: Builds the tier 3 GraphSpec: direct fetch and extraction nodes, the fallback tool loop, citation verification, rule-based comparison with computed confidence, an interrupt gate below the threshold, and finalize into a Verdict.

nodes.name: RunSummary
nodes.summary: Dataclass summarizing one run: stops, model and tool calls, corrections, first-pass result, context swaps and drops, tokens, cost and acceptance.

nodes.name: stops_in
nodes.summary: Extracts every early stop from a run's events: tool-loop stop reasons and context-ceiling refusals.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Builds a RunSummary from a run's guardrail events and run-log steps.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Writes one run_metrics row for a finished thread from its run log and events.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Aggregates run_metrics per graph and bundle into stop, tool-error, repeated-call, correction, first-pass and tokens-per-accepted-result rates.

nodes.name: fanout
nodes.summary: Reports, per task kind, how fanned-out reads went.

nodes.name: GateResult
nodes.summary: Result of the bundle regression gate for one graph: run counts, stop rates and verdict, with blocks() true when the candidate regresses.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: Blocks a candidate bundle whose share of loop or cap stops per graph exceeds the baseline's; too few candidate runs is 'insufficient', never a pass.

nodes.name: Caller
nodes.summary: Identifies a REST caller by role and user id and derives its api:<role> principal; the tenant comes from the session, never from the request.

nodes.name: openapi
nodes.summary: Generates the OpenAPI document for the tool endpoints from each ToolSpec's argument and output schemas, versioned by the bundle hash.

nodes.name: _status
nodes.summary: Maps a gateway result (denied, missing, invalid, rate-limited, malformed) onto an HTTP status code.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Answers one REST request in-process: lists the tools the caller may call, or runs one call through a Gate and a bound tool, logging the decision and returning status and body.

nodes.name: runlog.py
nodes.summary: Postgres-backed run log of every model turn and tool call keyed by request digest, so a resumed node reuses its recorded turns, a replay is served from the log (raising ReplayDiverged on a new request), and fence nonces stay stable across resumes.

nodes.name: state.py
nodes.summary: Defines the LangGraph AgentState TypedDict with a reducer on every field (chunk merging, coverage OR, keep-last, dict merge), so multi-writer updates merge deterministically and values stay JSON-serializable for any checkpointer.
nodes.languageNotes: Annotated[...] reducers on a TypedDict tell LangGraph how to merge concurrent node writes; even single-writer fields declare keep_last.

nodes.name: tier3.py
nodes.summary: Tier 3 evaluator wrapper: builds the tier 3 workflow per tenant, runs it on tenant-prefixed checkpointed threads, converts the final state to a Verdict, opens an approval item when the gate interrupts, resumes only from a recorded decision bound to the shown payload hash, and replays recorded runs against their log. Importing it registers the tier 3 evaluator.

nodes.name: tools.py
nodes.summary: Typed read-only tool registry: Pydantic argument and output schemas, ToolSpec declarations (class, scopes, untrusted flag, call and time limits, version), tenant-closed tool functions over ScopedDB for evidence search and reading, access, state, verdicts, controls, rollups and investigations, and the BoundTool gateway every call goes through.
nodes.languageNotes: Every argument model forbids extra fields and none has a tenant_id, so a model-supplied tenant is a validation error; absent data returns a 'missing' error rather than an empty list.

nodes.name: ReplayDiverged
nodes.summary: Raised when a replayed run makes a request its log does not hold.

nodes.name: steps_of
nodes.summary: Reads a run's recorded steps after a cursor for its run page, taken from the record rather than the model's account.

nodes.name: RunLog
nodes.summary: Run-scoped log over agent_steps: serves recorded chat turns, extractions and tool results by digest or tool_use id, records new ones as they return, and pins each node's fence nonce.

nodes.name: AgentState
nodes.summary: TypedDict of all agent graph state (tenant, test, chunks, coverage, tool log, extractions, citations, drafts, decisions, copilot and task fields), each field annotated with a merge reducer.

nodes.name: _build
nodes.summary: Constructs a tenant-scoped tier 3 graph: budget tracker, read-only agent pool, bound tools behind a policy Gate, model deps and the tenant checkpoint saver.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Streams the graph and appends each completed step, so a run that fails part way still records how far it got.

nodes.name: _interrupted_verdict
nodes.summary: Builds the needs_review Verdict returned at once when the graph stops at the gate.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs (or retries) a tier 3 evaluation for a subject: creates or resumes the thread, streams the graph, opens an approval item on interrupt, records spend and harness metrics, and returns the Verdict.

nodes.name: _recorded_decision
nodes.summary: Loads the named approval item, requiring it to belong to this thread and hold a recorded decision.

nodes.name: pending_payload_sha256
nodes.summary: Hashes the approval payload for the interrupt a thread is waiting on, or returns None.

nodes.name: resume
nodes.summary: Continues an interrupted thread only with the decision recorded on an approval item whose payload matches the pending interrupt, producing the final Verdict or returning to the gate on regather.

nodes.name: ReplayReport
nodes.summary: Result of replaying a recorded run: requests served, the first diverged request and the trajectory.

nodes.name: _NoModel
nodes.summary: Stand-in model client for replay that raises ReplayDiverged on any call, proving every request came from the log.

nodes.name: replay
nodes.summary: Re-runs a recorded tier 3 run on a scratch thread with every model turn, tool result and fence nonce served from its log and no model at all, stopping at the gate as the original did.

nodes.name: evaluate_subject
nodes.summary: Registered tier 3 entry point: loads the evaluation context and delegates to evaluate.

nodes.name: ToolSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen declaration of a tool: description, argument and output schemas, class (read, propose or act), scopes, untrusted flag, limits and version, with schema() for the model and contract() for the bundle hash and REST surface.

nodes.name: ToolContext
nodes.summary: What a bound tool may see: the tenant-scoped database plus the embedder, reranker and retrieval config.

nodes.name: search_evidence
nodes.summary: Hybrid search over the tenant's evidence chunks of one type, optionally filtered by subject and issue dates, returning redacted chunks with scores and model ids, or a missing-data error.

nodes.name: get_chunk
nodes.summary: Fetches one evidence chunk by id from the current index generations, redacted.

nodes.name: list_evidence
nodes.summary: Lists the current evidence rows of a type with titles, issue dates and source references.

nodes.name: get_evidence_chunks
nodes.summary: Returns every redacted chunk of one evidence entity.

nodes.name: find_exact
nodes.summary: Exact text or pattern search within current evidence documents, returning redacted matches with offsets and the chunks covering them.

nodes.name: outline
nodes.summary: Returns a document's heading outline, page count and span references for its chunks.

nodes.name: read_span
nodes.summary: Reads a bounded, redacted text span of an evidence document by offsets or page, with the chunks covering it.

nodes.name: find_access
nodes.summary: Joins current grants with canonical persons to answer who holds which access, filtered by employment status, asset prefix, role and state.

nodes.name: list_assets
nodes.summary: Lists current assets, optionally filtered by tag.

nodes.name: get_person
nodes.summary: Returns a canonical person with all linked accounts from identity resolution.

nodes.name: get_current_state
nodes.summary: Reads the bitemporal current compliance state for a test and subject, including any active exception.

nodes.name: get_verdict
nodes.summary: Loads a stored verdict with its reasoning, confidence, citations and evidence references.

nodes.name: list_findings
nodes.summary: Lists current findings from the bitemporal state heads, optionally filtered by status and test, labelled with exceptions.

nodes.name: get_access_grants
nodes.summary: Returns the current grants for every account of a canonical person.

nodes.name: get_control
nodes.summary: Returns a control's title, description, mapped framework requirements and tests from the knowledge graph.

nodes.name: get_framework_rollup
nodes.summary: Computes a framework's requirement rollup from state heads, inventory coverage and exceptions, flagging when no evaluations exist yet.

nodes.name: get_investigation
nodes.summary: Loads the stored investigation for a verdict: root cause, missing evidence, proposed actions and citations.

nodes.name: get_lookups
nodes.summary: Returns the stored lookups about a verdict's failing resources, without file text.

nodes.name: read_result
nodes.summary: Reads a redacted slice of a tool result this run stored whole, by its handle.

nodes.name: BoundTool
nodes.summary: The tool gateway: enforces the per-run call limit, pinned arguments, strict argument validation, the Rule of Two taint check and the policy Gate's decision, then runs the tool, validates its output, taints the run on untrusted content and reports timeouts and redactions.

nodes.name: bind_tools
nodes.summary: Binds the named tools to a context behind a Gate, dropping any tool the principal could never be permitted.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the Compliance Copilot terminal REPL, which runs on the same tenant-scoped tools and data as the evaluators; 'fix this' ends in an open approval, never in a change.

nodes.name: citations.py
nodes.summary: Post-generation citation verification: each cited field must reference a chunk the model was shown, quote a contiguous run of its words, and have its value supported by the quote (literal spans, unambiguous dates, status words without contradiction or negation). Failing fields are nulled, and coverage and citation-rate metrics are computed.

nodes.name: confidence.py
nodes.summary: Computes verdict confidence, never reported by the model, as the product of field coverage, citation rate and retrieval quality, then applies forcing caps for missing evidence, unresolved evidence types, injection markers and degraded providers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Registry of extraction schemas (gh4, hr3, hr4) with SchemaMeta for required and cited fields, plus lookups for the agent graphs' structured-output schemas and the system block that carries a schema to the model.

nodes.name: quote_supported
nodes.summary: Checks that a quote's words form one contiguous, in-order run of the chunk's words, tolerating punctuation and spacing but not splicing, reordering or paraphrase.

nodes.name: Support
nodes.summary: Rule describing how a quote must show a non-literal value: required words, forbidden words, pattern, subject reference and whether negation is allowed.

nodes.name: value_in_quote
nodes.summary: Checks that a literal value appears as one span of its quote, accepting unambiguous date spellings.

nodes.name: value_supported
nodes.summary: Evaluates a field's Support rule against its quote, rejecting contradictions and negated yes-values; None when the field has no rule.

nodes.name: check_value
nodes.summary: Returns None when the quote shows the field's value, otherwise the reason it does not.

nodes.name: VerifiedFields
nodes.summary: Result of field verification: kept values, citations, events and counts, with coverage, citation-rate and lost-required-citation properties.

nodes.name: verify_fields
nodes.summary: Verifies every cited field of a parsed extraction against the chunks shown, nulling unsupported fields and returning VerifiedFields.

nodes.name: Confidence
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding the computed confidence value, cap, component factors, forced status and events, with a summary formatter.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Multiplies coverage, citation rate and clamped retrieval quality under caps, forcing needs_review when required evidence is missing or unresolved and capping on injection or degraded providers.

nodes.name: SchemaMeta
nodes.summary: Metadata for an extraction schema: name, Pydantic model, version, required and cited fields, and the fields checked by value-in-quote.

nodes.name: schema_for
nodes.summary: Looks up an extraction schema's SchemaMeta by name.

nodes.name: schema_block
nodes.summary: Renders the system block that carries a model's JSON schema for tier 2, every structured node and replay.

nodes.name: schema_model
nodes.summary: Resolves any structured-output schema class by name, including the lazily imported agent schemas, for replay.

nodes.name: targets.py
nodes.summary: Registry of eval targets that golden cases invoke, each running one slice of the CCP pipeline (connector pull, landing, mapping, identity, tier 1-3 verdicts, retrieval, investigation, policy, Copilot, adversarial) against a per-run scratch database and returning a plain dict to compare.
nodes.languageNotes: A decorator factory (`@target(name)`) registers each function in a module-level TARGETS dict, and heavy or provider-specific modules are imported inside function bodies so only the targets that need them load them.

nodes.name: EvalContext
nodes.summary: Per-eval-run context holding settings, a lazily created scratch database pool and scratch directory, and caches of which tenants have been prepared, indexed and seeded with distractors; also carries judge and provider overrides for tests.

nodes.name: _RecordingConsumer
nodes.summary: OrderedConsumer subclass used only by evals that records the order in which event-log records are handled, backing the ingest_ordering target.

nodes.name: target
nodes.summary: Decorator factory that registers an eval target function under a name in the module-level TARGETS registry.

nodes.name: _support_precision
nodes.summary: Computes the fraction of extracted values whose cited quote actually contains the value, returning None when a verdict keeps no value-citation pairs.

nodes.name: connector_pull
nodes.summary: Eval target that pulls one connector and reports the event count, counts by event type and any events matching an optional filter.

nodes.name: ingest_land
nodes.summary: Eval target that lands one connector's events repeatedly into a scratch database and counts landed versus duplicate events to prove deduplication.

nodes.name: ingest_ordering
nodes.summary: Eval target that appends synthetic event-log records in a given order and reports the order an ordered consumer handled them.

nodes.name: mapper
nodes.summary: Eval target that maps one fixture event through the normalizer and reports the canonical entities produced.

nodes.name: knowledge_router
nodes.summary: Eval target returning the tier and control mapping the knowledge graph assigns to one test spec.

nodes.name: identity_pair
nodes.summary: Eval target that gates, scores and routes one pair of fixture persons in memory to check identity-resolution decisions without a database.

nodes.name: deterministic_verdict
nodes.summary: Eval target that runs one tier 1 test over the prepared tenant and reports each subject's verdict status.

nodes.name: evaluate_tier1
nodes.summary: Eval target that runs a full tier 1 evaluation twice, reporting status counts and proving the second run writes nothing new.

nodes.name: _indexed_db
nodes.summary: Ensures a prepared tenant has a retrieval index, and optionally distractor chunks, built once per run, returning its scoped database handle.

nodes.name: context_probe
nodes.summary: Eval target that runs one context probe over a task item run and grades it in code; requires the Anthropic provider.

nodes.name: chunker_pages
nodes.summary: Eval target reporting the chunks of one evidence row, the page each chunk sits on and where snippets land.

nodes.name: retrieval_metrics
nodes.summary: Eval target computing Recall@5, MRR and nDCG@10 over the golden query set for a tenant, with ablation flags.

nodes.name: tier2_verdict
nodes.summary: Eval target running one tier 2 LLM-assisted evaluation with the configured providers and reporting the verdict with citation support metrics.

nodes.name: tier3_verdict
nodes.summary: Eval target running one tier 3 agentic evaluation through the registered workflow and reporting its verdict.

nodes.name: investigation
nodes.summary: Eval target that evaluates one test, then runs the investigator on the resulting verdict for one subject.

nodes.name: policy_gap
nodes.summary: Eval target invoking the Policy Agent for one control to produce a gap analysis or a policy draft, checking that no other tenant's tokens leak.

nodes.name: copilot_answer
nodes.summary: Eval target running one Copilot turn on a fresh session and reporting the answer with forbidden-claim checks; nothing is confirmed.

nodes.name: adversarial_tier2
nodes.summary: Eval target running tier 2 over a corpus with one poisoned chunk and reporting whether the prompt-injection attack changed the verdict status.

nodes.name: pipeline
nodes.summary: Eval target running the full compliance-state pipeline for one tenant in the scratch database and reporting subject heads and framework rollups exactly.

nodes.name: make_event
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic SourceEvent for a tenant and connector, used by ordering evals.

nodes.name: aws_accounts.py
nodes.summary: Append-only store of AWS account onboarding records: the external ID CCP generated, the role ARN the customer supplied, and each verification outcome per account.

nodes.name: Onboarding
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one AWS account onboarding version: account, external ID, role ARN, status, findings and who recorded it.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Returns the current onboarding version for an AWS account, or None when it was never started.

nodes.name: all_accounts
nodes.summary: Lists the current onboarding version of every AWS account for the tenant.

nodes.name: _append
nodes.summary: Inserts a new onboarding version row for an account and returns it as an Onboarding.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts onboarding by validating the account id and minting a new external ID, or returns the existing record when the account was already started.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Appends a verification result for a started account, marking it verified or refused with its findings.

nodes.name: connections.py
nodes.summary: Manages tenant connections as versioned, append-only data: syncs declared connections from tenant config, probes their credentials daily, and derives connection health from checks and sync runs rather than storing it.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one credential probe of a connection: outcome, detail and time.

nodes.name: Health
nodes.summary: Derived health of a connection: state, reason, newest check and last complete run.

nodes.name: connection_id
nodes.summary: Builds a slug connection id from connector, source and account.

nodes.name: declared
nodes.summary: Resolves a tenant's configured connections into Connection objects, defaulting GitHub to the tenant's organization and other connectors to the tenant's own account.

nodes.name: _row
nodes.summary: Converts a current_connections row into a Connection object.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Lists the newest version of every connection, with verified AWS role parameters attached.

nodes.name: _with_params
nodes.summary: Attaches a verified AWS account's role ARN and external ID to an AWS connection; an unverified one carries none so its connector refuses to pull.

nodes.name: enabled
nodes.summary: Returns the tenant's enabled current connections.

nodes.name: for_pull
nodes.summary: Finds the enabled connection that a pull of a given connector and source belongs to, if declared.

nodes.name: _append
nodes.summary: Inserts a new connection version row inside a transaction.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: Brings the connections table in line with tenant configuration, appending versions for new, changed or no-longer-declared connections, idempotently across concurrent processes.

nodes.name: record_check
nodes.summary: Persists one connection check row.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Probes one connection's credential through its connector and records the outcome; a connector that cannot be built for want of a credential counts as a refusal.

nodes.name: check_all
nodes.summary: Daily job probing every enabled connection and recording each check.

nodes.name: derive
nodes.summary: Pure function deriving a connection's health state (disabled, auth_failed, not_visible, stale, degraded, healthy) and reason from its newest check and run history.

nodes.name: health
nodes.summary: Loads the newest check and sync runs for a connection and derives its health.

nodes.name: landing.py
nodes.summary: Lands connector events into the immutable raw zone and the event log with deduplication, and wraps every connector pull as a recorded sync run so one connector's failure never aborts the others or goes unrecorded.
nodes.languageNotes: Deduplication relies on INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in one short transaction per event, writing the raw file first so the database pointer never precedes the bytes.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.summary: Mutable running counts of landed and duplicate events, so a stream that fails part way still reports what it landed.

nodes.name: LandingSummary
nodes.summary: Aggregates a tenant ingest's sync runs: total landed and duplicates, per-connector counts and the failed runs.

nodes.name: land_events
nodes.summary: Lands a stream of events for one tenant, returning landed and duplicate counts.

nodes.name: _land_one
nodes.summary: Writes one event's bytes to the raw zone, inserts its raw_events pointer and appends it to the event log under its partition key; returns False for a duplicate.

nodes.name: _reobservation
nodes.summary: Decides whether a content-addressed event that repeats an earlier state is a real change because its stream has since moved on.

nodes.name: sync_connector
nodes.summary: Runs one connector's pull as a sync run: lands its events and responses, records how each scope ended, and turns pull errors into a failed run instead of raising.

nodes.name: land_responses
nodes.summary: Keeps every raw provider response a pull received, content-addressed in the raw zone.

nodes.name: land_received
nodes.summary: Lands received provider responses as raw evidence rows and returns their raw_responses ids, for pulls and lookups alike.

nodes.name: _failed_to_start
nodes.summary: Records a failed sync run with no scopes for a connector that could not even be built.

nodes.name: ingest_tenant
nodes.summary: Pulls every requested connector for one tenant, each as its own recorded sync run under its declared connection.

nodes.name: sync_connections
nodes.summary: Scheduled sync pulling every enabled connection for a tenant, each as its own recorded run.

nodes.name: _pull
nodes.summary: Builds one connector for a connection and runs its sync, recording a failed start when the build fails.

nodes.name: partition.py
nodes.summary: Computes event-log partition keys from tenant, connector and the subject an event is about, so ordering guarantees hold per subject.

nodes.name: _delivery_subject
nodes.summary: Extracts a member or membership user node id from a webhook-delivery style payload.

nodes.name: subject_of
nodes.summary: Returns the subject an event is about from known payload fields, the delivery payload, or the event id itself.

nodes.name: partition_key
nodes.summary: Builds the tenant:connector:subject partition key for an event.

nodes.name: raw_zone.py
nodes.summary: The immutable raw zone that stores every landed event and provider response either on local disk or in an Object-Locked S3 bucket, with content digests, version ids and duplicate tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a typing.Protocol (RawStore) that RawZone and S3RawZone satisfy structurally, so callers pick a backend through open_zone without inheritance.

nodes.name: LandedFile
nodes.summary: Pointer to a landed object: ref, payload and stored-bytes digests, version id, duplicate flag and store kind.

nodes.name: RawStore
nodes.summary: Protocol describing a raw store's write, put_response and read_bytes operations.

nodes.name: safe_id
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a source event id into a filesystem- and S3-safe key segment.

nodes.name: event_key
nodes.summary: Builds the tenant/connector/date/event-id key under which an event is stored.

nodes.name: parse_event
nodes.summary: Decodes stored raw bytes back into a SourceEvent, dropping landing metadata.

nodes.name: RawZone
nodes.summary: Local-disk raw zone for development and tests: writes each event once, sends repeats under dups/, and stores responses content-addressed.

nodes.name: S3RawZone
nodes.summary: S3-backed raw zone using Object Lock versioning: writes events and responses once, reads by version id and can place legal holds.

nodes.name: split_s3
nodes.summary: Parses an s3:// ref into bucket, key and its required version id.

nodes.name: open_zone
nodes.summary: Returns the raw store configured for this deployment: local disk or the S3 bucket.

nodes.name: read_bytes
nodes.summary: Reads the stored bytes behind any ref, a local path or an S3 object version.

nodes.name: read_ref
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the SourceEvent behind a raw zone ref.

nodes.name: fixes.py
nodes.summary: Loads and strictly validates the versioned fix catalogue (fixes.yaml) and checks a chosen fix and its parameters against declared patterns before anything is rendered.

nodes.name: Refused
nodes.summary: ValueError raised for an unknown fix or a parameter out of bounds.

nodes.name: TerraformSpec
nodes.summary: Declares how a fix changes Terraform: the kind of change, the block it acts on, its template or attribute and value, and allowed types.

nodes.name: Fix
nodes.summary: One catalogue fix: id, version, title, tests it fixes, parameter patterns, Terraform spec, CLI and console steps and how to verify.

nodes.name: _fix
nodes.summary: Parses and strictly validates one raw catalogue entry into a Fix, rejecting unknown keys and malformed templates.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the fix catalogue from YAML.

nodes.name: for_test
nodes.summary: Returns the fixes that address a given test's failing resources.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a fix by id, raising Refused when the catalogue has none.

nodes.name: check_params
nodes.summary: Ensures exactly the declared parameters are given and each is a string matching its pattern whole.

nodes.name: service_classes.py
nodes.summary: Loads service classes, their intents, the reviewed resource-type lookup and the coverage table, and lets a person approve a class for a newly seen AWS resource type.

nodes.name: Classes
nodes.summary: Loaded service-class data: intents per class, the type-to-class map and the covering test per type and intent.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads and validates service_classes.yaml, rejecting unknown classes or coverage for unclassified types.

nodes.name: propose_class
nodes.summary: Suggests a class for a resource type from its name, for a person to approve; None when nothing matches.

nodes.name: approve
nodes.summary: Records a person's approval of a class for a new type by appending one line to the YAML while keeping its comments, and logs the decision.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the lookups package, which reads evidence about failing resources before they are investigated.

nodes.name: coverage.py
nodes.summary: Builds the coverage map: every inventoried resource crossed with every intent of its service class, labelled pass, fail, pending, gap or not_assessed from deterministic verdicts and playbook results.

nodes.name: Row
nodes.summary: One coverage-map row: account, resource, service class, intent, status and the deciding test or verdict.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Computes coverage rows by joining the latest inventory snapshots, service classes, bitemporal verdict heads and playbook results.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Summarizes coverage rows into the headline numbers: unstatused resources, gaps and the share of intents decided by a deterministic test.

nodes.name: as_dicts
nodes.summary: Converts coverage rows to plain dicts for JSON output.

nodes.name: coverage_cli.py
nodes.summary: Typer CLI (`ccp coverage ...`) for taking the cloud inventory, showing the coverage map, approving service classes, diffing the AWS type registry and running gap playbooks.

nodes.name: take
nodes.summary: CLI command taking one inventory snapshot of a tenant's AWS account and printing the result.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: CLI command printing the coverage summary and optionally every resource and intent row.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: CLI command showing the proposed class for a new resource type or approving one as a named person.

nodes.name: registry
nodes.summary: CLI command comparing AWS's resource-type registry with the last kept list.

nodes.name: run_playbooks
nodes.summary: CLI command running today's gap playbooks, which record fail or needs_review and never pass.

nodes.name: inventory.py
nodes.summary: Takes daily AWS Config inventory snapshots per connection, landing responses as raw evidence first, and diffs the CloudFormation resource-type registry weekly, queueing new types for class approval.

nodes.name: Taken
nodes.summary: Result of one inventory snapshot: id, completeness, resource count, detail and unclassified types.

nodes.name: take
nodes.summary: Takes one inventory snapshot of the tenant's AWS account, landing raw responses and marking it incomplete when the Config recorder is off.

nodes.name: latest
nodes.summary: Returns the newest inventory snapshot of each account.

nodes.name: cloudformation_types
nodes.summary: Lists every public resource type in the CloudFormation registry using CCP's own credentials, touching no customer account.

nodes.name: queue
nodes.summary: Queues a new resource type once for a class decision and a drafted test, with a proposed class.

nodes.name: registry_diff
nodes.summary: Compares today's CloudFormation registry with the last kept list and queues the new types.

nodes.name: playbooks.py
nodes.summary: Runs service playbooks for coverage gaps: reads each resource's AWS Config, decides known fields in code, and otherwise asks a tool-less, fenced LLM call to cite JSON Pointers that code verifies, recording fail or needs_review but never pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic models with extra='forbid' and length limits constrain the model's structured output, and every cited JSON Pointer is re-resolved in code before it can affect a result.

nodes.name: CitedPath
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a JSON Pointer and the value the model claims it holds.

nodes.name: PlaybookReading
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for the model's reading: a finding (fail, unclear or no_issue), up to six cited paths and a short reason.

nodes.name: known_fields
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the per-type, per-intent known field specs from playbook_fields.yaml.

nodes.name: meets
nodes.summary: Checks a value against an expectation of equals, truthy or exists.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: Outcome of reading one gap: status, reason, cited paths and the model used.

nodes.name: by_code
nodes.summary: Decides a known field in code by resolving its JSON Pointer and comparing it to the expectation.

nodes.name: by_model
nodes.summary: Asks the model to read a fenced, invisible-character-stripped configuration, then verifies every cited pointer and value in code before deciding fail or needs_review.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.summary: Counts of a playbook run: read, failed, needs_review, nothing wrong and skipped.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Reads every coverage gap once a day within the tenant's cap and budget, landing configurations as raw evidence and recording fail or needs_review results.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Runs lookups about failing resources before investigation: queues one job per failing verdict with a plan, reads AWS Config history, CloudTrail events and the organization's Terraform for each resource, lands responses as raw evidence and queues the investigation.

nodes.name: Summary
nodes.summary: Counts of a lookups drain: consumed, enqueued, skipped, looked up, landed, investigations and lookup ids.

nodes.name: job_key
nodes.summary: Builds the tenant:verdict job key for a lookup job.

nodes.name: resource_id
nodes.summary: Returns the id AWS Config knows a failing resource by: a bucket's name or an IAM user's immutable id.

nodes.name: default_connectors
nodes.summary: Builds the tenant's enabled live connectors on first use, or returns None when the tenant is not connected.

nodes.name: history_result
nodes.summary: Turns AWS Config configuration items into an oldest-first history with what changed between successive states.

nodes.name: trail_result
nodes.summary: Shapes CloudTrail events that can change the setting into newest-first who, what and when rows.

nodes.name: code_result
nodes.summary: Lists code-search hits that name the resource together with the Terraform resource blocks that mention it.

nodes.name: _Run
nodes.summary: One verdict's lookup run: for each failing resource performs the planned Config, CloudTrail and code reads under rate limits, lands responses and records typed lookup rows.

nodes.name: look_up
nodes.summary: Runs a verdict's lookup plan once over its failing resources, returning the lookup ids written and responses landed.

nodes.name: queue_investigation
nodes.summary: Appends the verdict's investigation job to the event log once.

nodes.name: LookupsConsumer
nodes.summary: Ordered consumer of the verdicts topic that queues one lookup job per fail or needs_review verdict whose test has a lookup plan, making no network calls.

nodes.name: LookupJobs
nodes.summary: Parallel consumer that runs one verdict's lookups per job outside any transaction, then queues its investigation; a retried job with stored lookups only queues.

nodes.name: drain
nodes.summary: Queues lookups for every new failing verdict with a plan and runs them, each ending by queueing its investigation.

nodes.name: terraform.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight Terraform scanner that finds top-level resource blocks and their closing lines while skipping strings, comments and heredocs, and checks brace balance as the offline syntax check for rendered changes.

nodes.name: Block
nodes.summary: A top-level Terraform resource block: type, name, line span and text, with its type.name address.

nodes.name: _depth_change
nodes.summary: Computes one line's net brace depth change outside strings and comments, carrying an open heredoc's terminator between lines.

nodes.name: blocks
nodes.summary: Returns every closed top-level resource block in file order.

nodes.name: balanced
nodes.summary: Offline syntax check that braces close and no string or heredoc is left open.

nodes.name: _open_string
nodes.summary: Detects a line that ends inside an unterminated string literal.

nodes.name: mentioning
nodes.summary: Returns blocks of the given types whose text names a term as a quoted value.

nodes.name: fixes.py
nodes.summary: Renders fix suggestions from versioned templates in code and checks them offline (parameters, CLI safety, Terraform syntax and change scope) before anyone sees them; CCP suggests and a person applies.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Result of one offline check on a rendered suggestion: name, pass flag and detail.

nodes.name: Rendered
nodes.summary: A rendered fix suggestion with its params, Terraform change, CLI and console steps and checks, plus the displayed body and its payload hash.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills {name} placeholders in a template, leaving Terraform's own braces untouched and refusing unknown placeholders.

nodes.name: render_cli
nodes.summary: Renders CLI commands with shell-quoted parameters and checks each starts with the template's program and carries no shell control character.

nodes.name: _apply
nodes.summary: Applies a Terraform spec to file text: adds a block after, or sets an attribute inside, the target resource.

nodes.name: scope_check
nodes.summary: Checks a Terraform change only added, removed or changed the declared kinds of block around the target resource.

nodes.name: render_terraform
nodes.summary: Renders the change to the one file whose block names the resource, with syntax and scope checks; returns none when no file or several blocks match.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Checks parameters, fills every template and runs the offline checks to produce a Rendered suggestion.

nodes.name: segments.py
nodes.summary: Deterministically segments document versions into headings, sentences and table cells with stable ids, so a model cites segment ids or JSON Pointers and code renders the exact quote from stored text.

nodes.name: Segment
nodes.summary: One citable unit of a page: id, kind (heading, sentence or cell), page, offsets and text.

nodes.name: _sentences
nodes.summary: Splits running text into sentence segments with page offsets.

nodes.name: _cells
nodes.summary: Splits a pipe table's rows into one segment per cell, skipping rule lines.

nodes.name: segment_page
nodes.summary: Segments one page's text into heading, sentence and table-cell segments.

nodes.name: segment
nodes.summary: Segments every page of a document.

nodes.name: text_sha256
nodes.summary: Hashes a document's page texts to identify its version.

nodes.name: SegmentSet
nodes.summary: Stored segments for one evidence document version, with a lookup by segment id.

nodes.name: pages_of
nodes.summary: Returns the page texts, or the whole text as a single page.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Returns a document version's segments, creating and storing them once.

nodes.name: Rendered
nodes.summary: A rendered quote with per-segment pointers and the ids that were unknown.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the quote for cited segment ids from stored text, returning unknown ids instead of rendering them.

nodes.name: resolve_pointer
nodes.summary: Resolves an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a document, raising KeyError when it names nothing.

nodes.name: transcribe.py
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that transcribes scanned PDF pages and image uploads with Claude, verifying source bytes by digest, recording per-page transcriptions with cost, and landing a derived manual.transcribed raw event.

nodes.name: Transcription
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for one page's transcription: a legibility flag and the text.

nodes.name: TranscribeSummary
nodes.summary: Counts and cost of a transcription run: documents, pages, illegible pages, landed events and USD spent.

nodes.name: pending
nodes.summary: Lists upload events that carry an attachment and have no transcription yet.

nodes.name: _bytes
nodes.summary: Loads an upload's raw bytes from the raw zone and returns them only when they match the expected digest.

nodes.name: _attachments
nodes.summary: Builds model attachments per page from blank PDF pages split into one-page PDFs, or the image itself.

nodes.name: _transcribe_one
nodes.summary: Sends one attachment to the model for word-for-word transcription and tracks its cost.

nodes.name: transcribe
nodes.summary: Transcribes every pending upload within budget, records transcriptions and lands the derived events.

nodes.name: _derived
nodes.summary: Builds the manual.transcribed SourceEvent carrying the transcribed pages and methods.

nodes.name: tenancy.py
nodes.summary: Typed tenant identity: a TenantId NewType and the TenantContext resolved from the database's current tenant version with a tenants.yaml fallback, refusing suspended, offboarded or other-cell tenants.
