nodes.languageNotes: TenantId is a typing.NewType, so a bare string cannot stand in for a tenant without an explicit conversion; TenantContext is a frozen, slotted dataclass with classmethod constructors.

nodes.name: UnknownTenant
nodes.summary: Raised when a tenant id is neither in the database nor in the tenants file.

nodes.name: TenantUnavailable
nodes.summary: Raised when a tenant is suspended, offboarded or lives in another cell, so nothing runs for it.

nodes.name: forget
nodes.summary: Drops cached tenant reads, for one tenant or all, after a new version is recorded.

nodes.name: _stored
nodes.summary: Reads a tenant's current version settings and status from the database, tolerating an unmigrated or unreachable database.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.summary: Returns a tenant's current settings from the database, else the tenants file, refusing unavailable tenants.

nodes.name: directory
nodes.summary: Lists tenants onboarded into the database, empty when it cannot be read.

nodes.name: TenantContext
nodes.summary: Frozen tenant context (id and settings) that every function touching tenant data takes, with for_id and all constructors enforcing cell residency.

nodes.name: test_upload_containment.py
nodes.summary: Security tests ensuring manual-upload manifest entries are read only from inside the tenant's upload folder: escaping paths and links yield a manual.refused guardrail event and no evidence, while contained subfolders still work.

nodes.name: test_a_path_outside_the_tenant_folder_is_refused
nodes.summary: Parametrized test that parent, absolute and drive-relative manifest paths are refused and map to an upload_refused guardrail event with no entities.

nodes.name: test_a_link_that_leaves_the_tenant_folder_is_refused
nodes.summary: Tests that a symbolic link escaping the tenant folder is refused.

nodes.name: test_a_contained_subfolder_is_still_read
nodes.summary: Tests that a file in a contained subfolder is still read as a manual document.

nodes.name: test_contained_path_rules
nodes.summary: Unit-tests contained_path against valid and escaping relative and absolute paths.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines Cited, the chunk-id plus verbatim-quote citation model that every AI-extracted field carries so code can verify it against the fenced evidence it came from.

nodes.name: copilot.py
nodes.summary: Structured-output schemas for the Copilot (spec Layer 17): question intent classification, requested actions bounded by the shared action catalogue and ProposalTarget, and the cited answer draft, plus prompt and schema version constants.

nodes.name: gh4.py
nodes.summary: GH-4 extraction schema asking the model whether a vulnerability disclosure policy exists and states a timeline, with every boolean or text field paired with an optional Cited quote.

nodes.name: hr3.py
nodes.summary: HR-3 extraction schema for security training records: whether the document names the employee, its completion status, date and provider, each paired with an optional citation.

nodes.name: hr4.py
nodes.summary: HR-4 extraction schemas for two documents: the critical systems an inventory lists and the systems an access review states as in scope, each named system cited; code, not the model, compares them.

nodes.name: investigation.py
nodes.summary: The Investigator agent's structured-output schema (spec Layer 14): root-cause category, missing evidence, proposed actions from the closed ActionName enum with explicit targets, catalogue fix choices and citations. Reversible and live flags are deliberately absent so only the catalogue supplies them.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses closed pydantic objects (extra='forbid') and Literal enums because provider structured output needs closed schemas rather than free-form dicts.

nodes.name: policy.py
nodes.summary: Policy Agent structured-output schema (spec Layer 15): one gap per mapped requirement with a covered flag, verbatim citations and a gap description, rolled up into a gap report with a summary.

nodes.name: Cited
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic citation carrying the fence's chunk_id and a quote copied verbatim from that chunk; the shared building block of every extraction schema.

nodes.name: IntentDraft
nodes.summary: Copilot classify-step output: the question's intent (explain, status, missing, act, other) plus optional test id, subject hint and framework id.

nodes.name: RequestedAction
nodes.summary: An action the Copilot asks for, bounded by the closed ActionName enum and an explicit ProposalTarget, with a rationale and the verdict it would fix.

nodes.name: CopilotAnswerDraft
nodes.summary: The Copilot's answer schema: answer text, verified citations and the list of requested actions.

nodes.name: DisclosurePolicyFields
nodes.summary: GH-4 fields: whether a disclosure policy exists, whether it states a timeline, and the timeline text, each with an optional citation.

nodes.name: TrainingRecordFields
nodes.summary: HR-3 fields: whether the record names the subject, completion status, completion date and provider, each with an optional citation.

nodes.name: NamedSystem
nodes.summary: A system name with the citation that names it, shared by both HR-4 extraction schemas.

nodes.name: CriticalSystemsFields
nodes.summary: What the critical systems inventory lists, as cited named systems.

nodes.name: AccessReviewFields
nodes.summary: What the most recent access review says it covered: review date with citation and the systems in scope.

nodes.name: MissingEvidence
nodes.summary: Evidence the Investigator says is missing: an EvidenceType, optional subject key and why it is needed.

nodes.name: ProposalTarget
nodes.summary: Closed target object for a proposed action (repo, org, login, subject key, evidence type) with as_dict dropping empty fields.

nodes.name: ProposedAction
nodes.summary: A proposed remediation from the closed action catalogue with its explicit target and rationale.

nodes.name: FixParam
nodes.summary: A name/value parameter for a catalogue fix choice.

nodes.name: FixChoice
nodes.summary: A fix picked from the catalogue with its resource, parameters and rationale (A-160); code renders it, so the model never writes a command or diff.

nodes.name: InvestigationDraft
nodes.summary: The Investigator's full output: root cause and category, missing evidence, proposed actions, citations and optional fix choices.

nodes.name: PolicyGapDraft
nodes.summary: One requirement's coverage verdict from the Policy Agent: requirement id, covered flag, verbatim citations and a gap description when not covered.

nodes.name: GapReportDraft
nodes.summary: The Policy Agent's gap report: a list of per-requirement gaps and a summary.

nodes.name: task_item.py
nodes.summary: Schema for a task item's isolated read run (A-151): keyed readings with a closed answer, a one-line reason, at most eight cited findings and the evidence that would settle it, with length caps that keep sub-agent output small for the parent task.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Persistence layer for Investigator records (spec Layer 14): frozen Investigation and RemediationProposal models plus tenant-scoped insert and read helpers over the investigations table; also re-exports the model-facing draft schema.

nodes.name: actions.py
nodes.summary: The remediation action catalogue (spec Layer 10, A-33, A-131): the closed ActionName set, per-action reversibility and live capability, code-written risk templates, reversal mappings, and the risk summary shown with each approval, so none of it comes from a model.

nodes.name: prompts.py
nodes.summary: Loads versioned, never-edited prompt files from ccp/llm/prompts/<version>.md, returning their text and sha256 so verdicts and steps can name exactly which prompt was sent.

nodes.name: tracing.py
nodes.summary: Langfuse tracing behind a pluggable Sink protocol (spec Layer 12): turns step-log entries into nested observations grouped into one trace per run, provides recording and failing test doubles, a global payload mask hook, and a build_sink factory that degrades to no tracing when keys are missing or Langfuse is unreachable.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for the Sink seam so test doubles and the Langfuse adapter satisfy it structurally, and imports the Langfuse SDK lazily inside build_sink.

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: The questionnaire answering pipeline (A-163): maps a question to a tested control, reuses fresh library answers, derives a yes/no direction from current verdicts, retrieves evidence, runs tool-less fact and prose model steps over fenced chunks, and applies code checks before storing a draft for human approval.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Structured-output schemas for the questionnaire pipeline's two model steps: up to eight quote-backed facts, and the answer prose with a closed answer enum, plus their prompt version names.

nodes.name: ItemFinding
nodes.summary: A short (max 300 chars) claim about a task item with the citation that supports it.

nodes.name: KeyedReading
nodes.summary: One task item's reading: closed answer, one-line reason, up to eight cited findings and up to five notes on what evidence would settle it.

nodes.name: ItemReadings
nodes.summary: The read run's result: one keyed reading per task item it was given.

nodes.name: RemediationProposal
nodes.summary: Frozen proposal stored on an investigation, whose reversible and live_capable flags come from the action catalogue, never the model, plus the proposal row id once written.

nodes.name: Investigation
nodes.summary: Frozen, tenant-scoped investigation record: root cause, missing evidence, proposals, citations, bounded confidence, model and prompt version, guardrail events and the stored request and response for replay.

nodes.name: persist
nodes.summary: Inserts an Investigation into the investigations table, JSON-encoding nested evidence, proposals, citations, guardrail events and request/response payloads.

nodes.name: _from_row
nodes.summary: Rebuilds an Investigation from a database row, decoding and validating JSON columns into typed models.

nodes.name: for_verdict
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent investigation for a verdict, or None.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Loads one investigation by id from the tenant-scoped database, or None.

nodes.name: list_all
nodes.summary: Lists the newest investigations for the tenant up to a limit.

nodes.name: ActionSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen catalogue entry for a remediation action: name, reversibility, live capability, description and required target keys.

nodes.name: is_known
nodes.summary: Reports whether an action name is in the remediation catalogue.

nodes.name: Risk
nodes.summary: Code-written description of what an action changes, its reach, whether it is external and how to undo it, as templates over target keys (A-131).

nodes.name: risk_summary
nodes.summary: Renders the risk summary shown with an approval by filling an action's Risk templates from the target, marking missing keys, and stating whether it can run live.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a loaded prompt: version, text and sha256 digest.

nodes.name: load_prompt
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the prompt file for a version, failing loudly when missing, and returns it with its sha256.

nodes.name: prompt_files
nodes.summary: Lists every versioned prompt markdown file in sorted order.

nodes.name: register_mask
nodes.summary: Sets the global mask function every Langfuse payload passes through; the secrets module registers its redactor here to respect layer order.

nodes.name: registered_mask
nodes.summary: Returns the currently registered tracing payload mask, if any.

nodes.name: Sink
nodes.summary: Protocol for a tracing sink with start, end and flush, the seam between the step logger and Langfuse.

nodes.name: trace_key_for
nodes.summary: Derives a W3C-shaped 32-hex trace id from a run id so every step of a run lands in one trace.

nodes.name: RecordingSink
nodes.summary: Test double sink that records every started and ended span with nesting, outputs, usage and cost.

nodes.name: FailingSink
nodes.summary: Test double sink that raises on first use, proving emission is disabled without losing a step.

nodes.name: LangfuseSink
nodes.summary: Adapter emitting one Langfuse v3 observation per step, linking traces and parents via trace_context and mapping token usage and cost details.

nodes.name: default_probe
nodes.summary: Blocking startup health check against the Langfuse public health endpoint that raises when unreachable.

nodes.name: build_sink
nodes.summary: Factory returning a LangfuseSink or (None, warning): no keys or blank keys disable tracing, and an unreachable host or SDK failure yields a warning instead of an error.

nodes.name: map_control
nodes.summary: Maps a question to the tested control it names, otherwise to the single control whose question_map terms it contains most.

nodes.name: direction_of
nodes.summary: Derives yes, no, pending or undecided for a control from its tests' current states, with the deciding verdict ids and state counts.

nodes.name: evidence_types
nodes.summary: Chooses which evidence types to retrieve: always policy documents, plus the control's tests' evidence types or the type the question names.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Runs hybrid retrieval per evidence type and returns the top-K chunks overall by rerank or fused score.

nodes.name: _framed
nodes.summary: Wraps retrieved chunk dicts in prompt-guard evidence fences for a given nonce.

nodes.name: check_prose
nodes.summary: Code checks on the drafted answer: it follows the decided direction, every number appears in a fact or the question, and a substantive answer rests on a fact.

nodes.name: Drafted
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a drafted answer, its text, checked facts, check results, model name and cost.

nodes.name: _code_written
nodes.summary: Writes an answer without a model: a decided direction becomes a templated yes or no naming the control; anything else says no evidence decides it yet.

nodes.name: _drafted
nodes.summary: Runs the two tool-less model steps under a lowered budget: extracts facts from fenced chunks, drops facts whose quotes are not in the chunk, then writes prose from the fenced facts and direction and checks it.

nodes.name: answer_question
nodes.summary: Runs all stages for one question: mapping, a fresh library hit (auto-approved when autonomy allows), direction, retrieval and drafting, then records the draft with stages, checks and evidence pointers.

nodes.name: answer_all
nodes.summary: Drafts every question in a questionnaire that has no live answer, reading compliance facts once.

nodes.name: Fact
nodes.summary: A fact statement with the chunk id and verbatim quote code checks against that chunk, both length-capped.

nodes.name: FactsReading
nodes.summary: The facts step output: at most eight quote-backed facts.

nodes.name: AnswerProse
nodes.summary: The prose step output: a closed answer value and up to 1200 characters of answer text.

nodes.name: rebuild.py
nodes.summary: Implements `ccp replay`: finds a verdict, investigation, gap report or copilot answer, rebuilds its prompt, schema block and fenced evidence from stored references, diffs them against the stored request (reporting index drift separately), and can re-execute structured calls to diff responses.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the security primitives layer (spec Layer 13), which holds the secrets patterns and the prompt guard.

nodes.name: prompt_guard.py
nodes.summary: The single path for evidence and tool output into prompts (S2, S6, S16, A-98): redacts secrets, strips invisible Unicode, rejects fence collisions, flags injection marker phrases, wraps chunks in per-call random-nonce fences, truncates and fences tool results, and parses fences back for replay.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-call random nonces make the evidence fence unguessable while the cached system prefix stays byte-identical, since the fence is declared in the user turn.

nodes.name: secrets_patterns.py
nodes.summary: Plaintext secret detection and redaction (GH-5, A-96): ordered regex patterns for cloud, VCS, chat and LLM-provider credentials, line-based scanning with six-character previews, recursive redaction of JSON-like values, and registration of that mask for every tracing payload at import.
nodes.languageNotes: Registers its mask with the tracing module at import time, inverting the dependency so the lower observability layer never imports security code.

nodes.name: test_secret_redaction.py
nodes.summary: Database-backed security tests for S6 and S21: the planted GitHub token in acme's file listing fails GH-5, and reaches tool results, Copilot prompts, the step log and the trace payload only in redacted form.

nodes.name: test_tool_allowlist.py
nodes.summary: Security tests for S4 and S5: every agent graph rejects off-list tools at build time, hallucinated tool calls are refused before dispatch, the agent tools module has no write paths, tool arguments reject tenant_id and extra fields, and nodes without policies cannot be built.

nodes.name: ReplayCall
nodes.summary: Frozen result of replaying one model call: model, prompt version, schema, fenced chunk count, request diff lines and index drift.

nodes.name: ReplayReport
nodes.summary: Replay report for one record with all its calls, a flattened diff and a human-readable format method.

nodes.name: system_texts
nodes.summary: Public accessor for the system blocks a stored request sent, each with whether it was cached.

nodes.name: request_parts
nodes.summary: Splits a stored request, in stub or Anthropic API shape, into its instruction text and document blocks.

nodes.name: user_text
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the first user turn as one text with document blocks first, so replay and tests can find the fenced evidence.

nodes.name: _chunk_texts
nodes.summary: Fetches chunk text and metadata by id, falling back to versioned history for chunks no longer served by the index.

nodes.name: check_call
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the prompt text, schema block and fenced evidence for one stored call and diffs them against the request, reporting nonce mismatches as diffs and changed or missing chunks as drift.

nodes.name: _agent_calls
nodes.summary: Checks every recorded call of an agent run stored in request_json.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Looks up a record id as a verdict, investigation, gap report or copilot answer, returning its kind and record.

nodes.name: rebuild
nodes.summary: Builds the replay report for a record: tier-2 verdicts also rebuild the full user text from context and query, while agent records replay each stored call.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Re-sends every structured call of a record through an LLM client and diffs the parsed response fields; chat and tool calls are reported as not re-executable.

nodes.name: FramedChunk
nodes.summary: Frozen chunk to be fenced into a prompt: id, text, evidence type, subject, page and source reference.

nodes.name: Framed
nodes.summary: Framing result: the fenced text, shown and rejected chunk ids, guardrail events, and an injection_detected property.

nodes.name: new_nonce
nodes.summary: Generates a random 12-hex-character nonce for a per-call evidence fence.

nodes.name: fence_open
nodes.summary: Builds the opening fence line naming nonce, chunk id, type, subject and page.

nodes.name: fence_close
nodes.summary: Builds the closing fence line for a nonce.

nodes.name: fence_declaration
nodes.summary: The user-turn sentence declaring this call's evidence fence markers so the system prefix stays cacheable.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Returns the distinct injection-marker phrases found in a text, lower-cased and in order.

nodes.name: frame_evidence
nodes.summary: Frames evidence chunks for a prompt: redacts secrets, strips invisible characters, rejects chunks carrying the fence, flags injection markers, and wraps each chunk in nonce fences under the fixed framing sentence.

nodes.name: FencedBlock
nodes.summary: A parsed fenced evidence block: nonce, chunk id, evidence type and body.

nodes.name: parse_fences
nodes.summary: Parses fenced evidence blocks back out of prompt text exactly as frame_evidence laid them out; replay's only reader of the fence grammar.

nodes.name: strip_invisible
nodes.summary: Removes zero-width, joiner and bidirectional-control characters that can hide instructions, returning the cleaned text and count.

nodes.name: tool_fence_declaration
nodes.summary: Declares the tool-result fence markers for a conversation, includes the framing sentence and warns that truncated results are incomplete.

nodes.name: GuardedResult
nodes.summary: Frozen fenced tool result content with its guardrail events.

nodes.name: guard_tool_result
nodes.summary: Prepares a tool result for a model: redacts secrets, strips invisible characters, withholds payloads carrying the fence, flags injection markers, truncates at the limit with a visible marker, and fences it.

nodes.name: unfence_tool_result
nodes.summary: Extracts the payload from a fenced tool result for stubs and replay, or returns the content unchanged.

nodes.name: SecretFinding
nodes.summary: Frozen secret finding: pattern name, a six-character preview (never the full value) and line number.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Scans text line by line against every single-line secret pattern and returns findings with safe previews.

nodes.name: redact_value
nodes.summary: Recursively redacts every string inside a JSON-like value; used as the tracing payload mask.

nodes.name: redact
nodes.summary: Replaces every secret pattern match with [REDACTED:<pattern>] in order and returns the text and the pattern names hit.

nodes.name: redact_all
nodes.summary: Redacts a list of texts before they go to a third-party API.

nodes.name: world
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture preparing the acme tenant, indexing evidence and running GH-5 evaluation and state writing.

nodes.name: test_gh5_fails_on_the_planted_token
nodes.summary: Asserts GH-5 fails on the planted token and its verdict reasoning holds no full secret.

nodes.name: test_tool_results_carry_only_the_redacted_form
nodes.summary: Asserts get_chunk, get_evidence_chunks and search_evidence tool results return only the redacted token.

nodes.name: test_prompts_step_log_and_trace_payload_hold_only_the_redacted_form
nodes.summary: Runs a Copilot session with a listing stub and asserts the prompt, guardrail events, step log and recorded trace spans hold only the redacted token.

nodes.name: test_every_graph_rejects_an_off_list_tool_at_build_time
nodes.summary: Parametrized over every graph: off-list tools raise ToolNotAllowed while the allowed set passes.

nodes.name: test_tier3_and_policy_lists_exclude_what_the_spec_says
nodes.summary: Asserts the tier3, policy and investigator allowlists exclude the tools the spec forbids and the copilot list covers every tool.

nodes.name: test_a_hallucinated_tool_call_is_refused_and_never_dispatched
nodes.summary: Drives a tool loop with a stub calling an unknown tool and asserts it is refused with a guardrail event and no side effect fires.

nodes.name: test_tools_import_nothing_with_side_effects_and_open_no_write_path
nodes.summary: Parses ccp/agent/tools.py with ast and asserts it imports no side-effecting modules and contains no SQL write verbs.

nodes.name: test_no_tool_accepts_a_tenant_id_and_extra_fields_are_rejected
nodes.summary: Asserts no tool argument model has tenant_id, all forbid extra fields, and a bound tool refuses a tenant_id argument.

nodes.name: test_a_node_without_policies_cannot_be_built
nodes.summary: Asserts graph validation rejects nodes without policies and unknown graph names.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Module entry point that makes `python -m ccp` invoke the Typer CLI application defined in ccp/cli.py.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Top-level Typer CLI of the compliance platform: mounts every sub-app (tenants, db, connectors, ingest, worker, evals, index, identity, state, rules, audit, bundles, aws, members, api and more) and implements their commands, each opening a tenant-scoped database pool and delegating to the domain modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Typer sub-apps are composed with add_typer; several imports exist only for their side effect of registering consumers and scheduled jobs (marked noqa: F401), and heavy dependencies such as uvicorn, boto3 and the retrieval compare/gate modules are imported lazily inside the commands that need them.

nodes.name: run_pipeline
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp run`: runs the full ingest, normalize, resolve, index, evaluate and state-writing pipeline for one tenant from fixture or live sources and prints the report.

nodes.name: state_current
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp state current`: prints the open compliance-state row per subject, or for one subject, annotated with any active exception.

nodes.name: state_history
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp state history`: prints every compliance-state row ever recorded for a subject in recorded order.

nodes.name: state_asof
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp state asof`: answers the bitemporal audit question of a subject's state at a valid time as it was known at a given knowledge time.

nodes.name: evaluate_run
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evaluate run`: refreshes the retrieval index, enqueues every test/subject pair or drains entity changes through the impact step, then drains evaluations and prints counts by status, parking AI tiers when no API key is set.

nodes.name: index_rebuild
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index rebuild`: drops, re-chunks, optionally re-enriches and re-embeds every current evidence row.

nodes.name: index_refresh
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index refresh`: indexes only new or changed evidence, treating unchanged chunks as no-ops.

nodes.name: _index
nodes.summary: Shared helper behind index rebuild and refresh: builds providers, refreshes the tenant's retrieval index and prints chunking, embedding, enrichment and cost statistics.

nodes.name: index_stats
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index stats`: prints chunk counts by evidence type, the embedding models present and distractor counts.

nodes.name: index_distractors
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index distractors`: installs or clears generated distractor chunks used for retrieval evaluation and calibration.

nodes.name: index_calibrate
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index calibrate`: measures the distractor noise floor and reliability curves over golden queries and optionally writes them into config/retrieval.yaml.

nodes.name: index_compare
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index compare`: paired comparison of a candidate embedder and reranker against the serving generation across every tenant's golden queries, building the candidate generation and writing a JSON summary without switching.

nodes.name: index_gate
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index gate`: evaluates per-evidence-type retrieval gates over every tenant's golden queries and exits non-zero on blocking breaches.

nodes.name: index_generations
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index generations`: lists every index generation (embedding model by chunker) with its sets, chunk versions and which one serves.

nodes.name: index_reembed
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index reembed`: embeds evidence into a new generation beside the serving one and switches only when the gate passes or the switch is forced.

nodes.name: index_search
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp index search`: runs a hybrid retrieval query, optionally as of a time or on a named generation, and prints candidates with FTS and cosine ranks, fused and rerank scores.

nodes.name: evaluate_list
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evaluate list`: prints the newest verdict per subject, optionally for one test.

nodes.name: evaluate_clock
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evaluate clock`: performs one clock tick, enqueueing subjects whose verdict or evidence has gone stale.

nodes.name: knowledge_show
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp knowledge show`: prints each test in the knowledge graph with its tier, controls and the requirements they satisfy.

nodes.name: knowledge_load
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp knowledge load`: upserts the knowledge graph of frameworks, controls and tests into the reference tables.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp report`: rolls current compliance state, coverage and exceptions up to a framework's requirements (SOC 2 or ISO 27001).

nodes.name: identity_resolve
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp identity resolve`: blocks, gates, scores and routes every candidate identity pair for a tenant and prints route counts.

nodes.name: identity_review
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp identity review`: lists open identity review items with their approval items, or resolves one as merge or distinct through a signed-in approver's approval action.

nodes.name: normalize_run
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp normalize run`: drains every raw topic for a tenant into the canonical entity tables and prints current entity counts.

nodes.name: ingest_run
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp ingest run`: pulls the tenant's connectors, lands events in the raw zone and event log, prints each sync run's scope outcomes and exits non-zero on failure.

nodes.name: connections_list
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp connections list`: syncs and prints the tenant's connections with health derived from their checks and sync runs.

nodes.name: connections_check
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp connections check`: probes every enabled connection's credential now and exits non-zero when any check fails.

nodes.name: ingest_transcribe
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp ingest transcribe`: transcribes scanned pages and screenshots with Claude and lands the text for normalization.

nodes.name: ingest_runs
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp ingest runs`: prints the tenant's latest sync runs, newest first, with each scope's outcome.

nodes.name: worker_run
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp worker run`: runs a registered event-log consumer for one or all tenants, draining once or polling.

nodes.name: worker_list
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp worker list`: prints the names of all registered consumers.

nodes.name: worker_dead_letters
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp worker dead-letters`: lists dead-lettered records across parallel topics and ordered topics per consumer.

nodes.name: worker_replay
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp worker replay`: replays a dead-lettered record (back to pending, or re-run per ordered consumer) and exits non-zero when a re-run fails again.

nodes.name: worker_unpark
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp worker unpark`: returns parked records on a topic to pending.

nodes.name: _eval_selection
nodes.summary: Loads golden cases for a suite and filters them by level, tag or case id, raising a CLI parameter error when none match.

nodes.name: evals_publish
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals publish`: writes this quarter's quality snapshot per AI workflow from a run report and prints each bound or withholding reason.

nodes.name: evals_card
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals card`: prints the method card of one verdict as JSON.

nodes.name: evals_size
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals size`: reports whether each AI target's gold set has enough FAIL cases and FAIL share to bound its false-PASS rate, exiting 1 when one cannot.

nodes.name: evals_shadow
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals shadow`: re-sends stored tier-2 requests to a candidate model, prints rule-decided status flips and exits 1 when any flip goes towards PASS.

nodes.name: evals_refusals
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals refusals`: prints each test's model refusal rate over a window of days.

nodes.name: evals_run
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals run`: runs the selected golden or adversarial cases plus unit tests, writes the run report and exits 1 on any failure.

nodes.name: evals_calibrate
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals calibrate`: runs the LLM judge over the labelled set and reports agreement and kappa with bootstrap intervals.

nodes.name: evals_regress
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals regress`: reruns the suite, diffs it against a baseline under the eval gates and judge agreement, promotes the report to latest only when clean, and exits with the regression code.

nodes.name: evals_labels
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals labels`: exports reviewer labels on tier-3 drafts as labelled-set intake to a YAML file outside the repository.

nodes.name: evals_relabel
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals relabel`: lists the month's judged items for expert relabelling, records a label, or checks expert-judge agreement against the judge's calibration.

nodes.name: evals_capture
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals capture`: turns a trace from the step log into a golden case with its replay material.

nodes.name: evals_threshold
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evals threshold`: shows the interrupt threshold suggested by the last run's reliability curve and optionally writes it, refusing to lower the human gate without --allow-lower.

nodes.name: auth_dev_token
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp auth dev-token`: mints a sign-in token from the local dev issuer, allowed only in dev auth mode.

nodes.name: members_list
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp members list`: prints the tenant's members and their roles.

nodes.name: members_grant
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp members grant`: grants a role to a principal from the server command line, recorded as granted by the operator.

nodes.name: members_revoke
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp members revoke`: ends a principal's membership, recorded as revoked by the operator.

nodes.name: rules_preview
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp rules preview`: shows each subject's last verdict under an older rule beside what the current rule decides from the same inputs, marking status changes.

nodes.name: rules_correct
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp rules correct`: re-decides a test's past verdicts under its current rule (requiring sign-off when a FAIL would become a PASS), drains state writes and prints the notice.

nodes.name: rules_notices
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp rules notices`: lists every rule change notice recorded for the tenant, oldest first.

nodes.name: evaluate_sentinel
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp evaluate sentinel`: re-derives the newest tier-1 verdicts of a sample of subjects from what each read and exits 1 on any mismatch.

nodes.name: replay_record
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp replay`: re-derives a tier-1 verdict, or rebuilds a stored model request from its references and diffs it against what was sent, optionally re-executing it against the live model.

nodes.name: connectors_conformance
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp connectors conformance`: runs every live connector's recorded scenarios offline with negative controls and exits 1 on a failed scenario or an uncaught control.

nodes.name: connectors_pull
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp connectors pull`: pulls one connector for a tenant and prints each SourceEvent inside an observability step, without landing them.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp serve`: serves the signed-in, tenant-scoped HTTP API through uvicorn.

nodes.name: bundles_show
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp bundles show`: prints the release bundle id this process runs under and its manifest.

nodes.name: bundles_diff
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp bundles diff`: prints what changed between two recorded release bundle manifests.

nodes.name: bundles_coverage
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp bundles coverage`: counts verdicts and agent runs per release bundle and exits 1 if any record names no bundle.

nodes.name: aws_onboard
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp aws onboard`: starts AWS account onboarding by generating the external ID and printing the CloudFormation quick-create link for the read-only role.

nodes.name: aws_verify
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp aws verify`: verifies the customer's role works only with CCP's external ID and can neither write nor read secrets, recording the outcome and exiting 1 when refused.

nodes.name: audit_verify_cmd
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp audit verify`: walks the tenant's audit hash chain, re-hashing chained rows and checking checkpoints, and exits 1 on any finding.

nodes.name: audit_checkpoint_cmd
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp audit checkpoint`: signs and exports the tenant's audit chain head now.

nodes.name: audit_raw
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp audit raw`: re-reads every raw object by its pointer and hash, printing missing or altered objects and exiting 1 if any.

nodes.name: tenants_list
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp tenants list`: lists the active tenants with their key settings.

nodes.name: tenants_create
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp tenants create`: onboards a new tenant with its first settings version and first admin, without a deploy.

nodes.name: tenants_show
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp tenants show`: prints the tenant settings in force and the version they come from.

nodes.name: tenants_history
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp tenants history`: lists the tenant's settings versions with status, reason, author and approval.

nodes.name: tenants_set
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp tenants set`: changes tenant settings as an authenticated admin, routing a change of scope to an approver.

nodes.name: db_migrate
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp db migrate`: applies pending migrations as the admin role inside an observability step.

nodes.name: db_check
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp db check`: connects as the application role and prints what the server looks like.

nodes.name: db_lint
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp db lint`: runs the row-level-security catalogue lint and exits 1 on any finding.

nodes.name: api_openapi
nodes.summary: CLI `ccp api openapi`: generates the OpenAPI 3.1 document of the tool routes from the registry, to stdout or a file.

nodes.name: autonomy.py
nodes.summary: Governs which AI drafts may skip human review per (tenant, workflow, decision class): records autonomy levels, allows promotion to 'sampled' only on a published quality snapshot measured on the current release bundle, makes seeded-sample and daily-exposure-budget decisions, demotes on bundle change or quality alarms, and simulates a candidate level over past drafts.
nodes.languageNotes: Sampling is deterministic: a SHA-256 of tenant, workflow, class and item id is reduced modulo 1000, so the same draft is always sampled the same way and the simulator reproduces live decisions.

nodes.name: policy
nodes.summary: Loads and caches config/autonomy.yaml: the decision classes, the promotion bar and the exposure budget.

nodes.name: class_rules
nodes.summary: Returns the autonomy rules of one workflow/decision class, raising when the class is not declared in autonomy.yaml.

nodes.name: latest_snapshot
nodes.summary: Reads the newest published quality snapshot JSON for a workflow.

nodes.name: Current
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the autonomy level in force for a class: level id, level, quality snapshot and bundle id.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Fetches the latest autonomy level for a workflow/decision class, defaulting to approve_each when none is recorded.

nodes.name: _record
nodes.summary: Inserts a new autonomy_levels row with the level, snapshot, bundle, setter and reason, returning its id.

nodes.name: promotion_problems
nodes.summary: Lists every reason a class cannot be promoted to sampled: not reversible and low impact, a missing or wrong-bundle snapshot, a withheld or too-high false-accept bound, too few FAIL cases, or low pass^k.

nodes.name: set_level
nodes.summary: Administrator action setting a class's autonomy level, refusing 'sampled' unless the latest published snapshot meets every promotion bar on the current release bundle.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Decides whether a draft goes to review or, at sampled level, is auto-accepted, sampled for review by seeded hash, or over the daily exposure budget, recording each decision with its snapshot.

nodes.name: watch
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that demotes every sampled class to approve_each when the release bundle changed or a quality alarm failed within the last day.

nodes.name: Simulation
nodes.summary: Frozen counts from simulating the sampled level: items, auto-accepted, sampled for review, over budget and false accepts.

nodes.name: simulate
nodes.summary: Replays past drafts and their human outcomes through the sampled level to count would-be auto-accepts and how many of those a person had changed or rejected.

nodes.name: questionnaire_history
nodes.summary: Derives past questionnaire drafts of one source with what a person did to each (accepted, changed or rejected) as simulator input.

nodes.name: probes.py
nodes.summary: Code-graded context probes for the long-task harness: under squeezed context ceilings they check that a planted fact survives, swapped-out tool results can be re-read intact by handle, a resumed task redoes no finished work, and cited spans land in the correct document section.

nodes.name: ProbeResult
nodes.summary: Result record of one context probe: name, pass flag and detail.

nodes.name: _task
nodes.summary: Plans a questionnaire task with the given questions and advances it once with a single-run reader.

nodes.name: planted_fact
nodes.summary: Probe checking that a code planted in the question is echoed in the reading and still present in the run's last model call under squeezed context ceilings.

nodes.name: reread_by_handle
nodes.summary: Probe checking that swapped-out search results are stored whole, read back unchanged by handle, and that the reading's cited chunks rest on them.

nodes.name: resume_without_redo
nodes.summary: Probe checking that re-advancing a task redoes no finished item and that restarting a finished run under its own id makes no new model call.

nodes.name: cited_span_positions
nodes.summary: Probe checking that facts early, in the middle and late in a policy document are cited at offsets falling inside the correct section.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Dispatches a named context probe, raising on an unknown name.

nodes.name: publish.py
nodes.summary: Produces method cards explaining from recorded facts how a verdict or fix suggestion was decided, and publishes quarterly per-workflow quality snapshots (false-PASS rate and upper bound, pass^k, models, prompt versions, dataset hash) that withhold bounds resting on too few FAIL-labelled cases.

nodes.name: method
nodes.summary: Loads the evaluation method configuration from config/eval_method.yaml.

nodes.name: quarter
nodes.summary: Formats a datetime as a YYYY-Qn quarter label.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Frozen published quality snapshot for one AI workflow and bundle: case counts, false-PASS rate and upper bound or withholding reason, pass^k, models, prompt versions, dataset hash, recertification date and method.

nodes.name: snapshots
nodes.summary: Builds a quality snapshot per AI workflow from a run report, computing the false-PASS upper bound (zero-failure or Clopper-Pearson) only when enough FAIL-labelled cases exist.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Writes each workflow snapshot to evals/published/<quarter>/<workflow>-<bundle>.json and returns the written paths.

nodes.name: latest_published
nodes.summary: Reads the newest published snapshot for a workflow.

nodes.name: verdict_card
nodes.summary: Builds a method card for one verdict from recorded facts: rule or model, versions, bundle, evidence provenance, citation checks, confidence and the workflow's latest published quality.

nodes.name: suggestion_card
nodes.summary: Builds a method card for one fix suggestion: how it was chosen and rendered, template hash, checks, lookups and status.

nodes.name: shadow.py
nodes.summary: Shadow-diffs a candidate tier-2 model against stored requests: replays each recorded request to the candidate, applies the test's own rule to stored and candidate fields, collects status flips (especially towards PASS) and records the run as a quality check without ever writing a verdict.

nodes.name: Flip
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a verdict whose rule-decided status would change under the candidate model, with the fields that differ.

nodes.name: ShadowReport
nodes.summary: Shadow run result with compared/skipped counts and flips; exposes flips towards PASS and passes only when there are none.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Replays stored tier-2 requests to a candidate model, applies each test's rule to stored and candidate fields, collects status flips and records the run as a shadow quality check.

nodes.name: sizing.py
nodes.summary: Sizes golden datasets against a false-PASS bound: computes how many FAIL cases are needed for a bound at a confidence, the zero-failure upper bound, and per-AI-target FAIL counts and FAIL-share findings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the closed-form zero-failure binomial bound 1 - (1 - c)^(1/n) instead of a statistics library.

nodes.name: fail_cases_needed
nodes.summary: Computes how many FAIL cases with zero false passes are needed to bound the false-PASS rate at a given bound and confidence.

nodes.name: upper_bound
nodes.summary: Returns the one-sided false-PASS upper bound when none of n FAIL cases passed.

nodes.name: TargetSize
nodes.summary: Per-AI-target sizing result exposing the FAIL share and findings when FAIL cases or share fall short.

nodes.name: size
nodes.summary: Groups golden cases by AI target and reports each target's FAIL-labelled count against the number needed for the bound.

nodes.name: adequacy.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed adequacy verifier deciding whether an uploaded evidence document would satisfy an auditor: frames numbered segments inside prompt-injection fences, validates the model's segment citations in code, calibrates against auditor labels with a Clopper-Pearson false-accept bound, and runs shadow-first as a parallel event-log job consumer.
nodes.languageNotes: The job consumer registers itself at import time through the worker's register decorator, so importing the module is what makes the 'adequacy' consumer available.

nodes.name: controls_for
nodes.summary: Lists the tests that read an evidence type, with their controls' titles, from the knowledge graph.

nodes.name: numbered
nodes.summary: Renders a segment set as lines prefixed by their segment ids.

nodes.name: Verification
nodes.summary: Result of verifying one document: decision, reasons with rendered quotes, summary, model, cost and guardrail events.

nodes.name: check_reading
nodes.summary: Code checks on the model's adequacy reading: drops unknown segment ids, renders quotes, and turns an accept citing no control-showing segment into a flag.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Runs one tool-less model extraction over a fenced, numbered document with its target controls as system data and returns the code-checked verification with model, cost and events.

nodes.name: label
nodes.summary: Records an auditor's accept-or-flag decision on the newest version of a document.

nodes.name: clopper_pearson_upper
nodes.summary: Computes the exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound on a failure rate by bisection on the binomial tail.

nodes.name: Calibration
nodes.summary: Frozen verifier-versus-auditor calibration result: pairs, agreement, auditor flags, false accepts, upper bound, pass flag and reasons.

nodes.name: calibrate
nodes.summary: Compares the verifier's latest decisions with auditors' on the same document versions, checks label count, agreement and false-accept bound, and records an adequacy quality check.

nodes.name: calibrated
nodes.summary: Returns whether the newest adequacy calibration quality check passed.

nodes.name: effective_mode
nodes.summary: Returns the configured adequacy mode, downgrading live to shadow until calibration passes.

nodes.name: run_one
nodes.summary: Verifies one admissible document version once and records the result as evidence feedback, shown only in live mode.

nodes.name: AdequacyJobs
nodes.summary: Parallel event-log consumer that runs one adequacy verification per upload version and parks when no model key is available.

nodes.name: drain
nodes.summary: Runs the adequacy job consumer until its queue is empty and returns how many documents were verified.

nodes.name: adequacy.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for the adequacy verifier's structured answer: an accept/flag decision with coded reasons that cite segment ids rather than quotes, plus the prompt and schema version constants.

nodes.name: AdequacyReason
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of one coded adequacy reason citing up to eight segment ids with a short note.

nodes.name: AdequacyReading
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of the verifier's answer: accept or flag, up to six reasons and a summary.

nodes.name: quality.py
nodes.summary: Records model refusals per test and release bundle and computes per-test refusal rates over a time window as a production quality signal.

nodes.name: Rate
nodes.summary: Frozen per-test refusal and attempt counts with a computed refusal rate.

nodes.name: record_refusal
nodes.summary: Inserts a model refusal row tagged with the test and current release bundle.

nodes.name: refusal_rates
nodes.summary: Computes per-test refusal rates since a time as refusals over refusals plus AI verdicts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for identity resolution, documenting its block, gate, score, route and log-every-decision design.

nodes.name: raw_audit.py
nodes.summary: Audits the raw zone by re-reading every raw event and provider response object through its stored pointer and re-hashing it, reporting missing, altered and unversioned rows.

nodes.name: RawAudit
nodes.summary: Mutable tally of a raw-zone audit: checked, unversioned, missing and altered objects; clean when nothing is missing or altered.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Re-reads every versioned raw event and every raw response by its ref and hashes it against the recorded digest.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the model seam: one client interface, one error taxonomy and one budget shared by every AI layer.

nodes.name: release.py
nodes.summary: Computes release bundle ids: hashes a manifest of every model role, per-model behaviour, the agent prompt-and-tool bundle, the rule catalogue version and config file digests, caches it per model set, persists manifests once and diffs two manifests.
nodes.languageNotes: The agent bundle is loaded with importlib.import_module to avoid an upward import into the agent layer, and the digest is cached with functools.lru_cache.

nodes.name: roles
nodes.summary: Maps every AI role (tier 2 and 3, agents, judge, second reader, adequacy, questionnaire, playbook, embedder) to its configured model id.

nodes.name: manifest
nodes.summary: Assembles the release manifest: model roles, per-model thinking and effort behaviour, the agent prompt-and-tool bundle hash, the rule catalogue version and config file digests.

nodes.name: bundle_id
nodes.summary: Returns the 16-hex release bundle id for the settings, computing and caching the manifest digest per model set.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Persists a computed bundle manifest into release_bundles once, inside the caller's transaction.

nodes.name: manifest_of
nodes.summary: Returns a manifest this process computed for a bundle id.

nodes.name: differences
nodes.summary: Recursively diffs two manifests into dotted-path change lines.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for security questionnaires answered by a fixed drafting pipeline.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for replay: rebuilding a stored model request from its references and diffing it against what was sent, using only the database and prompt files.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for long-running tasks: typed task and item rows, code planners and the task runner.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: The task runner and sole authority over task and item status: plans tasks with cost forecasts, caps and deadlines, advances them pass by pass (code-settled checks, follow-ups, model reads through a pluggable reader, budget/deadline/stall parking and cost alerts), and handles human resolve, answer, cancel and resume.

nodes.name: ReadOutcome
nodes.summary: What the reader did with the open read items in a pass: runs, changes, spend and events.

nodes.name: PassSummary
nodes.summary: Summary of one runner pass over a task: status, checks, changes, added items, waiting reads, runs, spend, park reason and events.

nodes.name: item_cost
nodes.summary: Returns the p95 dollar cost of one read run of a task kind once 20 runs exist, otherwise the configured per-item cost.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Plans a task via its kind's code planner, forecasting cost and defaulting the dollar cap and deadline, and stores it under the current release bundle.

nodes.name: _park
nodes.summary: Parks a task with a reason and updates the pass summary.

nodes.name: _alert
nodes.summary: Records a one-time cost alert when a task's spend exceeds the alert factor times its forecast.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Runs one pass over an open task: parks on deadline, settles check items from facts, adds follow-ups, rechecks reads by code, hands remaining reads to the reader under the budget cap, then marks done, parks on budget or stall, or records the pass.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Lets a person settle a held item (needs_review, waiting or open) as final with an outcome and note.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Records a person's answer to a waiting item's open question and reopens the item for the next pass.

nodes.name: cancel
nodes.summary: Cancels a task that is not already done or cancelled, recording who and why.

nodes.name: resume
nodes.summary: Reopens a parked task, optionally with a new deadline or dollar cap, recording the change.

nodes.name: gaps
nodes.summary: Builds the task's gap list as a query over item rows: verdict gaps, not-yet-known checks, readings and unread items.

nodes.name: advance_open
nodes.summary: Scheduled job that advances every open task once and counts them.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: Typed persistence layer for long tasks: Task, Item and NewItem row models and the only writer of tasks, task_items, task_events and task_answers, recording every status change as an insert-only event in the same transaction.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Frozen task row: kind, scope, status, caps, forecast, deadline, spend, pass counters, alert flag and bundle, with a from_row constructor.

nodes.name: Item
nodes.summary: Frozen task item row: kind, question, inputs, status, outcome, attempts, evidence ids, open question, last run and result, with a settled property.

nodes.name: NewItem
nodes.summary: Planner-written item specification: item key, kind, question and typed inputs.

nodes.name: event
nodes.summary: Inserts one task_events row with optional item, run and spend.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a task, all its planner items and a 'planned' event in one transaction, rejecting duplicate item ids.

nodes.name: add_items
nodes.summary: Idempotently adds follow-up items to a running task and records an items_added event.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Fetches one task by id.

nodes.name: list_tasks
nodes.summary: Lists tasks, optionally filtered by status, newest first.

nodes.name: items_of
nodes.summary: Lists a task's items ordered by item id.

nodes.name: item
nodes.summary: Fetches one item of a task.

nodes.name: events
nodes.summary: Lists a task's events as dictionaries in recorded order.

nodes.name: set_item
nodes.summary: Updates one item's status and any provided fields and records an item_status event in the same transaction; unset fields keep their value.

nodes.name: set_task
nodes.summary: Updates a task's status, counters, alert flag or park reason and records a task event in the same transaction.

nodes.name: charge
nodes.summary: Adds a run's spend to its task and returns the new total.

nodes.name: run_costs
nodes.summary: Returns the dollar costs of the most recent finished read runs for a task kind, used for forecasting.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Stores a person's answer to an item's open question exactly as given.

nodes.name: answers_of
nodes.summary: Lists the answers recorded for a task item.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package docstring for the audit module (spec A-137) describing its three parts: checkpoint signing, signed chain-head checkpoints exported outside the database, and the verifier that re-walks the chain.

nodes.name: checkpoints.py
nodes.summary: Creates signed checkpoints of each tenant's audit-chain head, exports them write-once to a local directory or an S3 Object Lock compliance-mode bucket, and records them in audit_checkpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: CheckpointStore is a typing.Protocol, so the local and S3 stores are swapped structurally without inheritance.

nodes.name: Checkpoint
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one signed checkpoint: tenant, chain seq and entry hash, signed statement, signature, key id, export reference and signing time.

nodes.name: CheckpointStore
nodes.summary: Protocol for write-once checkpoint export targets with put and get by reference.

nodes.name: LocalCheckpointStore
nodes.summary: Directory-backed checkpoint store for offline use and tests that refuses to overwrite an existing checkpoint file.

nodes.name: S3CheckpointStore
nodes.summary: S3 checkpoint store that writes each object under COMPLIANCE-mode Object Lock with a retention date and reads it back by versioned s3 reference.

nodes.name: store_for
nodes.summary: Factory that returns an S3 checkpoint store when an audit bucket is configured, otherwise a local directory store under the data dir.

nodes.name: head
nodes.summary: Returns the tenant's latest audit-chain seq and entry hash, or None for an empty chain.

nodes.name: latest
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently recorded checkpoint, or None.

nodes.name: recorded
nodes.summary: Reads every recorded checkpoint for the tenant from audit_checkpoints into Checkpoint records, decoding JSON statements.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Signs the tenant's chain head as a canonical statement, exports it to the store, and inserts it into audit_checkpoints; returns None when the chain is empty or unchanged since the last checkpoint.

nodes.name: package_verify.py
nodes.summary: Standalone offline verifier for audit packages (A-168): checks file digests, the manifest and checkpoint signatures, recomputes the hash-chain segment to the signed head, and confirms each result's chained row; needs only the standard library and cryptography so an auditor can run it alone.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serializes a document as canonical JSON bytes, matching the signer's format, for signature checks.

nodes.name: sha256_file
nodes.summary: Returns the hex SHA-256 digest of a file's bytes.

nodes.name: entry_of
nodes.summary: Recomputes one audit-chain entry hash as sha256(prev|seq|table|row digest).

nodes.name: check_signature
nodes.summary: Verifies a base64 signature against a PEM public key, supporting Ed25519 and ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 keys.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Mutable verification report holding ok, whether the key was pinned, counts of what was checked, and the list of problems.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Checks an audit package folder offline in order: manifest file digests, manifest signature, checkpoint signature and tenant, chain recomputation to the signed head, and each result's chained row.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse entry point that verifies a package folder, optionally with a separately obtained public key, prints the report as JSON and exits non-zero on failure.

nodes.name: signing.py
nodes.summary: Checkpoint signing abstraction: a Signer protocol with an Ed25519 LocalSigner for offline use and tests and an AWS KMS ECDSA P-256 KmsSigner for production, plus canonical JSON and base64 helpers.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serializes a statement as canonical JSON bytes (sorted keys, no spaces) so signatures are reproducible.

nodes.name: Signer
nodes.summary: Protocol for checkpoint signers exposing key_id, sign, verify and public_key_pem.

nodes.name: LocalSigner
nodes.summary: Ed25519 signer that loads or generates a PEM private key in the data directory, derives a key id from the public key hash, and signs, verifies and exports the public key.

nodes.name: KmsSigner
nodes.summary: AWS KMS asymmetric signer using ECDSA_SHA_256 whose private key never leaves KMS; converts the DER public key to PEM for packages.

nodes.name: signer_for
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a KmsSigner when a KMS key id is configured, otherwise a LocalSigner backed by a key file under the data dir.

nodes.name: b64
nodes.summary: Base64-encodes bytes to ASCII text.

nodes.name: unb64
nodes.summary: Decodes base64 ASCII text back to bytes.

nodes.name: verify.py
nodes.summary: Implements `ccp audit verify`: walks the tenant's audit hash chain for gaps and broken links, re-hashes every chained row across the chained tables to find missing, altered or unchained rows, and checks each checkpoint's signature and external export.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds SQL per chained table, joining on primary-key columns discovered from pg_index and hashing jsonb restricted to the columns recorded at chaining time, under SET LOCAL TimeZone = 'UTC'.

nodes.name: AuditReport
nodes.summary: Accumulates counts of chain entries, rows and checkpoints checked plus findings; clean only when there are no findings.

nodes.name: _chain
nodes.summary: Walks audit_chain in seq order from the genesis hash, reporting gaps, broken links and entries that do not hash to their recorded value; returns entry hashes by seq.

nodes.name: _rows
nodes.summary: Re-hashes every chained row of each chained table in UTC over its recorded columns, reporting missing, altered and never-chained rows.

nodes.name: _checkpoints
nodes.summary: Checks each recorded checkpoint's key id and signature, consistency with its statement and with the chain entry it signed, and that the external export matches the database.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Runs chain, row and checkpoint verification for the tenant and returns the combined AuditReport.

nodes.name: packages.py
nodes.summary: Builds as-of audit packages (A-168): bitemporal results for one framework at valid_at/known_at with method, raw evidence pointers and chain proofs, a chain segment, an optional correction delta, and a signed manifest sealed write-once and registered in audit_packages; also exposes Typer build and verify commands.

nodes.name: _raw_pointers
nodes.summary: For each evidence entity a verdict read, finds the newest observation known at known_at across entity tables and returns its raw event reference, stored digest, version and store.

nodes.name: _proof
nodes.summary: Returns a verdict row's chained JSON text exactly as the audit chain hashed it, together with its chain seq.

nodes.name: results_as_of
nodes.summary: Collects every subject result for a framework's tests as of valid_at and known_at via the bitemporal read, with requirements covered, status, verdict method, raw evidence pointers and chain proof.

nodes.name: _chain
nodes.summary: Reads the audit-chain segment between two seq numbers as JSON-ready dicts for chain.json.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Assembles an audit package: computes results (or a correction delta against a prior package), takes a signed checkpoint, writes results, chain and corrections files, signs a manifest with file digests and public key, seals every file write-once, and registers the package.

nodes.name: build_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that resolves the tenant, parses the as-of time as UTC, opens a pool and builds a package, printing its id and folder.

nodes.name: verify_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that verifies a package folder offline with an optional pinned public key and exits 1 on any failure.

nodes.name: drafting.py
nodes.summary: Offline model drafting of declarative checks (A-165): an LLM drafts a check as structured data from test metadata and fenced tenant samples, four code gates (compile, paths, fixtures, shadow) vet it, and a named reviewer's accept promotes it into knowledge/checks as a new catalogue version.
nodes.languageNotes: The model's output is constrained to strict Pydantic models (extra='forbid', Literal fields) so a draft is data, never code.

nodes.name: DraftCondition
nodes.summary: Strict Pydantic model for one drafted condition: a field, a test operator from a fixed set, and the value as JSON text.

nodes.name: DraftedCheck
nodes.summary: Strict Pydantic schema the model fills: source collection, read/population/require conditions, abstain reason, and fail, pass and failing-list texts.

nodes.name: to_document
nodes.summary: Converts a DraftedCheck into the YAML document shape a declarative check file holds.

nodes.name: Gates
nodes.summary: Results of the compile, paths, fixtures and shadow gates with any shadow diffs; passed only when all four pass.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Frozen tenant-level evaluation result: status, failing count, and failing names when known.

nodes.name: _baseline
nodes.summary: Runs today's deterministic or declarative evaluator for the test across subjects and reduces it to one tenant-level Outcome at the worst status.

nodes.name: check_gates
nodes.summary: Validates a drafted check document and runs the four gates against each tenant: compile, field paths that resolve on recorded entities, error-free fixtures, and shadow agreement with today's evaluator or labels.

nodes.name: _samples
nodes.summary: Collects up to five recorded entities per tenant from the source collection, dumped as JSON without text fields, for the drafting prompt.

nodes.name: draft
nodes.summary: Makes one tool-less structured LLM call that drafts a declarative check from the test metadata, the entity's field schema and fenced tenant samples, under a lowered budget.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Writes the drafted check YAML and its gate results JSON into the knowledge check_drafts folder.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Records a named reviewer's accept or reject of a draft; an accept requires all gates passed, promotes the check into knowledge/checks, and logs catalogue versions before and after.

nodes.name: spec_of
nodes.summary: Looks up a TestSpec by id in the loaded knowledge graph or raises.

nodes.name: draft_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that drafts a check with the model for given tenants, runs the gates and saves both for review.

nodes.name: review_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that applies exactly one of accept or reject to a drafted check by a named reviewer.

nodes.name: mapping.py
nodes.summary: Framework-mapping workflow commands (A-164): batches code-ranked mapping proposals, optionally lets a tool-less model choose among or abstain from code's candidates, and exposes propose, review and eval Typer commands.

nodes.name: MappingChoice
nodes.summary: Strict Pydantic schema for the model's mapping choice: up to three control ids, abstain flag, confidence and reason.

nodes.name: refine
nodes.summary: Lets a tool-less model choose among code's ranked candidate controls for one requirement or abstain, dropping any control code did not rank and keeping the model's confidence beside code's.

nodes.name: propose_batch
nodes.summary: Scores a framework file's requirements against the catalogue, optionally refines non-abstained proposals with the model, and writes a timestamped proposal batch JSON for review.

nodes.name: propose_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that builds a mapping proposal batch, with or without the model, and prints each requirement's proposals.

nodes.name: review_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that records one reviewer's accept or reject of a single requirement-to-control mapping.

nodes.name: eval_cmd
nodes.summary: Typer command that reports held-out precision and recall at 3 for a framework with known mappings.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the framework and control knowledge layer (spec Layer 6): framework > requirement > control > test.

nodes.name: admissibility.py
nodes.summary: Code-only admissibility checks for uploaded evidence (A-161): applies per-evidence-type rules from admissibility.yaml for issue date, age, period, subject, issuer and visible-date match, returning blocking or warning reason codes and a provenance badge.

nodes.name: Rules
nodes.summary: Frozen per-evidence-type admissibility rules: maximum age, whether a period, subject or issuer is required, and visible-date tolerance.

nodes.name: rules_for
nodes.summary: Merges the default and evidence-type-specific admissibility rules from the YAML file into a Rules record.

nodes.name: Reason
nodes.summary: Frozen admissibility reason with a code, block or warn severity, and detail.

nodes.name: Admissibility
nodes.summary: Admissibility result carrying a provenance badge and reasons; admissible when no reason blocks, serializable as a dict.

nodes.name: visible_dates
nodes.summary: Extracts dates written in a document's text in ISO form and in month-name form such as 'Sep 1, 2026'.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Normalizes a datetime, date or ISO string into a timezone-aware UTC datetime, or None.

nodes.name: transcribed
nodes.summary: Reports whether any page was model-transcribed, blank or illegible, marking the document as image-like.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Applies every code-checkable admissibility rule to one document version (issue date, future date, age, transcription state, period, subject, issuer, visible-date match, attested images) and returns badge plus reasons.

nodes.name: catalogue.py
nodes.summary: Computes the catalogue version (A-128): a cached 12-character SHA-256 over the framework, control, test, impact and declarative-check YAML files in a fixed order.

nodes.name: files
nodes.summary: Lists the catalogue's existing YAML files in a fixed order: frameworks, controls, tests, impact table and declarative checks.

nodes.name: version
nodes.summary: Cached catalogue version: a 12-character SHA-256 over each catalogue file's relative path and newline-normalized bytes.

nodes.name: graph.py
nodes.summary: Defines the knowledge-graph models (Framework, Requirement, Control, TestSpec, KnowledgeGraph) with cross-reference validation, the tier router, the YAML loader, and the upsert into reference tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen Pydantic v2 models with field_validator and model_validator(mode='after') enforce referential integrity across the whole graph at load time.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model of a framework requirement with id, title, intent and clauses.

nodes.name: Framework
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model of a compliance framework with its requirements and a lookup by requirement id.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model of a control mapping to framework:requirement references and to tests, with per-framework requirement filtering.

nodes.name: TestSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic test specification (evaluation mode, evidence types, subject kind, rule, completeness scopes, freshness) that validates declared connector scopes and interpretive/deterministic consistency and exposes its tier.

nodes.name: tier_for
nodes.summary: The router: deterministic tests go to tier 1, interpretive tests with one evidence type to tier 2, otherwise tier 3.

nodes.name: KnowledgeGraph
nodes.summary: Frozen graph of frameworks, controls and tests that validates every cross-reference resolves and answers controls-for-test, tests-for-requirement and controls-for-requirement queries.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads framework YAML files plus controls.yaml and tests.yaml from the knowledge directory into a validated KnowledgeGraph.

nodes.name: load_into_db
nodes.summary: Upserts frameworks, requirements, controls, tests and their mapping edges into the reference tables in one transaction and returns counts.

nodes.name: lookups.py
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the per-test lookup table (A-158) that tells code which AWS Config history, CloudTrail events and Terraform resource types to read about a failing resource.

nodes.name: TrailLookup
nodes.summary: Frozen CloudTrail lookup spec: search by resource name or event source, the event names, and the source when needed.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: Frozen per-test lookup plan naming the connector, AWS Config resource type, CloudTrail lookup and Terraform resource types, with the derived lookup kinds.

nodes.name: _plan
nodes.summary: Validates one lookups.yaml entry's keys, CloudTrail spec, infra_code list and infra_search mode and builds a Plan.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Cached loader that parses lookups.yaml into Plans keyed by test id.

nodes.name: plan_for
nodes.summary: Returns the lookup plan for a test id, or None.

nodes.name: mapping.py
nodes.summary: Code-scored framework-to-control mapping (A-164): ranks controls per requirement by text cosine and cross-framework transfer similarity, proposes or abstains, measures held-out precision and recall at 3, and writes reviewer-accepted mappings into controls.yaml with a review log.

nodes.name: tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenizes text into a counter of lowercased content words with simple plural stripping and stop-word removal.

nodes.name: cosine
nodes.summary: Cosine similarity between two word-count vectors.

nodes.name: requirement_text
nodes.summary: Joins a requirement's title, intent and clauses into one text for scoring.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: Frozen candidate control with combined score and its text and transfer components.

nodes.name: Proposal
nodes.summary: Frozen mapping proposal for one requirement: ranked candidates, proposed controls, confidence, abstention, method, model reason and events, serializable as a dict.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Scores every control for a requirement as the mean of text cosine and the best transfer similarity to the control's requirements in other frameworks, best first.

nodes.name: propose
nodes.summary: Builds one proposal per requirement from the top three candidates, proposing those within 60% of the best and abstaining below the minimum score.

nodes.name: HeldOut
nodes.summary: Frozen held-out evaluation result: requirement count, precision and recall at 3, and abstentions.

nodes.name: held_out
nodes.summary: Measures precision and recall at k of code scoring against a framework's existing mappings, excluding that framework from the transfer signal.

nodes.name: _add_reference
nodes.summary: Adds a requirement reference to a control's flow-style requirements list in controls.yaml in place, preserving comments and order; False when already mapped.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Records a named reviewer's decision on one mapping; an accept copies a draft framework live if needed, adds the reference to controls.yaml, and logs catalogue versions before and after.

nodes.name: tenant_catalogue.py
nodes.summary: Overlays a tenant's custom controls, tests and checks from knowledge/tenants/<tenant>/ on the common catalogue, refusing to replace common entries, and computes a tenant catalogue version covering both.

nodes.name: overlay_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the tenant's overlay directory under knowledge/tenants.

nodes.name: files
nodes.summary: Lists the tenant overlay's existing controls.yaml, tests.yaml and check files.

nodes.name: load_for
nodes.summary: Loads the common knowledge graph and adds the tenant's own tests and controls, refusing any that would replace a common entry, then revalidates the combined graph.

nodes.name: version
nodes.summary: Returns the common catalogue version, or a hash over it plus the tenant's own files when the tenant has an overlay.

nodes.name: admission.py
nodes.summary: Decides whether an uploaded evidence document counts for retrieval (A-161) by loading its manifest and front matter from the raw event and running code admissibility checks; blocked model-transcribed uploads are left out of the index.

nodes.name: raw_context
nodes.summary: Reads the manifest entry and front matter an upload landed with from its raw event, returning empty dicts when absent or unreadable.

nodes.name: assess
nodes.summary: Runs the code admissibility check for one evidence row using its raw-event manifest and front matter.

nodes.name: counted
nodes.summary: Returns False only for an uploaded, model-transcribed document with a blocking admissibility reason; everything else counts.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the single CCP container image on python:3.12-slim with uv from the frozen lockfile, copying the ccp package and config directory and running as non-root uid 10001; the same image runs both the `ccp serve` API and the `ccp worker run` worker services (A-138).
nodes.languageNotes: Dependencies are synced with `--no-install-project` before the source is copied, so the dependency layer stays cached across code-only changes; a second `uv sync` then installs the project itself.

nodes.name: app
nodes.summary: The `app` stage: Python 3.12 slim runtime with the uv-built virtualenv on PATH, CCP_DATA_DIR at /app/data, port 8000 exposed, and `ccp serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000` as the default command (the worker service overrides the command).

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Local development stack with a single Postgres 17 service on the pgvector image (database `ccp`, port 5432, pg_isready healthcheck) and a named `pgdata` volume; it is the only stateful dependency needed to run CCP and its database tests on a laptop.

nodes.name: postgres
nodes.summary: The `ccp-postgres` container from pgvector/pgvector:pg17 with superuser credentials for local use, a healthcheck retried up to 20 times, and data persisted in the `pgdata` volume.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Keyless CI workflow on every push and pull request: with a pgvector Postgres service it runs ruff format and lint, strict mypy, import-linter, `ccp db migrate`, pytest (excluding live_github), and the keyless golden eval suite, then uploads evals/runs/latest.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs without any model, embedding or tracing keys by design, so keyed tests and eval cases skip cleanly; the keyed run lives in nightly-evals.yml.

nodes.name: deploy.yml
nodes.summary: Deploys main to an AWS cell: a gate job repeats the CI checks plus a strict eval regression, then the deploy job assumes an OIDC role, builds and pushes the image to ECR, runs `ccp db migrate` as a one-off Fargate task, and rolls the api and worker ECS services with a new task definition; a manual dispatch with `rollback_to` redeploys a named image and skips the gates and migration.
nodes.languageNotes: A per-cell `concurrency` group with cancel-in-progress false serializes deploys; `always() && (needs.gate.result == 'success' || inputs.rollback_to)` lets a rollback run even though the gate job was skipped.

nodes.name: nightly-evals.yml
nodes.summary: Nightly (03:17 UTC) and on-demand keyed evaluation run: golden and adversarial suites at five runs per case, regressed strictly against the last good baseline restored from the Actions cache, then judge calibration with bootstrap, an inline Python cost-cap check on the newest report, and upload of reports and calibration files.
nodes.languageNotes: Keyed steps use continue-on-error so the cost cap and artifact upload still run; a final step fails the job from `steps.<id>.outcome`. Secrets are scoped to the two steps that call a model rather than the whole job.

nodes.name: 0001_schema.sql
nodes.summary: Baseline Phase 0 migration that enables pgvector, defines the app_tenant() guard every row-level security policy calls, and creates the Layer 2 ingestion tables: raw_events, the Kafka stand-in event_log, consumer_offsets and dead_letter.
